  107: node_enrollment_remote_custodian(Config) ->
  108:     Source = ?config(asker, Config), Custodian = ?config(target, Config),
  109:     SourceKey = ?config(asker_pub, Config), HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  110:     SourceAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT}, HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config),
  111:     NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  112:     NodeSource = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/quod_node.pl"),
  113:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "enrollment-class"),
  114:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
  115:         [NodeNs, #{node_id => SourceKey, mode => create, data_dir => NodeDir,
  116:                    seed_peers => [], genesis_file => NodeSource,
  117:                    external_predicate_modules => [quod_ontology_predicates]}]),
  118:     ok = peer:call(Source, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready, [NodeNs, {isa, node, agent}], 15000),
  119:     NodeAnchor = peer:call(Source, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [NodeNs]),
  120:     start_brahms(Source, NodeNs, SourceAddr, []),
  121:     {ok, Template} = file:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  122:                                                  "ontologies/node_execution.pl")),
  123:     HostNs = <<"node:remote-custodian">>,
  124:     Options = quod_ct:node_identity_options(HostNs, me, HostKey),
  125:     {ok, [#{'A' := HostAnchor}], _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  126:         [?ROOT_NS, {create_ontology, HostNs, Options, {'A'}}], 30000),
  127:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  128:         [HostNs, {instance_of, node, me}], 15000),
  129:     Host = {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me},
  130:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  131:         [HostNs, {assertz, {ontology_hosting_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  132:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, execute, [NodeNs, {transaction, {',',
  133:         {assertz, {node_identity_template, Template}},
  134:         {assertz, {node_identity_allocation, HostKey, Host, Host}}}}]),
  135:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  136:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creation_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  137:     ok = enrollment_route(Source, HostKey, HostAddr,
  138:         [{?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}, {HostNs, HostAnchor, validator}]),
  139:     ok = enrollment_route(Custodian, SourceKey, SourceAddr, [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  140:     {Public, _} = Pair = quod_identity:generate(),
  141:     {ok, Instance} = quod_client_goal_parser:format({enrolling, Public}),
  142:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(#{network_identity => ?config(network_id, Config),
  143:         signing_public_key => Public, operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  144:         agent_namespace => NodeNs, agent_genesis_anchor => NodeAnchor,
  145:         agent_instance_text => Instance, mode => execute, parser_version => 3,
  146:         not_after_ms => quod_time:now_ms() + 30000, goal_text => <<"enroll_node(Ref).">>}),
  147:     Sig = quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(Pair)),
  148:     Result = peer:call(Source, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000),
  149:     case Result of
  150:         {ok, _, {normalized, {failed, Reasons}}} ->
  151:             ct:fail({enrollment_failed, quod_wire_term:decode_failure_reasons(Reasons)});
  152:         _ -> ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
  153:     end,
  154:     {ok, [#{'Ref' := {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, me} = Ref}], _} =
  155:         peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  156:             [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, {'Ref'}, Host}]),
  157:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  158:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  159:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  160:         [Ns, {agent_key, me, Public, active}], 15000),
  161:     ?assertEqual({error, not_hosted},
  162:         peer:call(Source, quod_ontology, genesis_anchor, [Ns])),
  163:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  164:         [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, Ref, Host}])),
  165:     %% No publication or follow has primed this newly created identity yet.
  166:     Cost = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_local_evidence_cost,
  167:                   [{Ns, Anchor}, [{HostKey, [HostAddr]}]], 20000),
  168:     ct:pal("Unchanged current reads: ~p", [Cost]),
  169:     automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor, Host).
  170: 
  171: automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor,
  172:                       {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me} = Host) ->
  173:     Custodian = ?config(target, Config), Applicant = ?config(third, Config),
  174:     HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config), NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  175:     HostDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "custodian-identity"),
  176:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "applicant-identity"),
  177:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, HostDir]),
  178:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  179:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_node_actor, verify, [HostBlob, ?config(target_pub, Config)]),
  180:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, quod_identity, store_node_actor_pointer, [HostDir, HostBlob]),
  181:     {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [HostNs, HostCfg]}}} =
  182:         peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, get_childspec,
  183:             [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, HostNs}]),
  184:     HostDataDir = peer:call(Custodian, quod_ledger_store, ledger_dir, [HostCfg]),
  185:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env,
  186:         [quod, content_data_dir, HostDataDir]),
  187:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, content_data_dir, NodeDir]),
  188:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Dir, Contacts}) ->
  189:         {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [?ROOT_NS, RootCfg]}}} =
  190:             peer:call(Peer, supervisor, get_childspec,
  191:                 [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, ?ROOT_NS}]),
  192:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env,
  193:             [quod, namespace_static_content, #{?ROOT_NS => RootCfg}]),
  194:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child,
  195:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  196:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child,
  197:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  198:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, directory,
  199:             #{identity_dir => Dir, root_contacts => Contacts}]),
  200:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  201:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  202:         ok = peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, start_tracking, [])
  203:     end, [{Custodian, HostDir, []}, {Applicant, NodeDir, [HostAddr]}]),
  204:     ok = enrollment_route(Applicant, ?config(asker_pub, Config), {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  205:          [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  206:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  207:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {system_ontology, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  208:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, NodeDir]),
  209:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_complete, [], 60000),
  210:     {ok, Blob} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_identity, load_node_actor_pointer, [NodeDir]),
  211:     {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}, reference := Ref}} = quod_agent_ref:decode(Blob),
  212:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])),
  213:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS])),
  214:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  215:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  216:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  217:         [Ns, {hosts_ontology, Ref, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  218:     {ok, Bytes, Sig} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_node_actor, signed_goal,
  219:         [read, true, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000]),
  220:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}},
  221:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000)),
  222:     %% The custodian must validate an observer's publication even though its
  223:     %% own local member is the identity's sole current-tip answerer.
  224:     ApplicantAuthor = {node_actor, Blob},
  225:     {ok, First} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  226:                             [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, none], 20000),
  227:     %% No new resync request: renew on the existing authenticated stream and
  228:     %% observe the received generation, not a send trace.
  229:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  230:                         [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, First], 20000),
  231:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  232:     HostAuthor = {node_actor, HostBlob},
  233:     {ok, HostFirst} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  234:                               [HostAuthor, Host, none], 20000),
  235:     {ok, BeforeRestart} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  236:                         [HostAuthor, Host, HostFirst], 20000),
  237:     HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  238:     #{control_links := BeforeLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  239:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  240:     {_, OldLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, BeforeLinks),
  241:     %% The transport survives a directory-only restart. Its peer-opened
  242:     %% streams must reset so the new owner acquires fresh subscriptions.
  243:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, terminate_child,
  244:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  245:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, restart_child,
  246:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  247:     {ok, Recovered} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  248:         [HostAuthor, Host, BeforeRestart], 20000),
  249:     #{control_links := AfterLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  250:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  251:     {_, NewLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, AfterLinks),
  252:     ?assertNotEqual(OldLink, NewLink),
  253:     #{subscribers := Subscribers} = peer:call(Custodian,
  254:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  255:     %% The source peer may also subscribe to this root custodian. Require
  256:     %% exactly one stream per peer, including the restarted applicant link.
  257:     SubscriberKeys = [Key || {Key, _} <- maps:values(Subscribers)],
  258:     ApplicantKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  259:     ?assertEqual([ApplicantKey], [Key || Key <- SubscriberKeys, Key =:= ApplicantKey]),
  260:     ?assertEqual(lists:sort(SubscriberKeys), lists:usort(SubscriberKeys)),
  261:     ?assertMatch(#{control_link_count := 1},
  262:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_directory_control, stats, [])),
  263:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  264:         [HostAuthor, Host, Recovered], 20000).
