  266: enrollment_local_evidence_cost(Identity, Sources) ->
  267:     Owner = quod_reg:where({foreign_log, node}),
  268:     Calls = [{quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence, 9},
  269:              {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity, 3},
  270:              {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, 1},
  271:              {quod_ledger_store, open, 3}, {quod_ledger_store, open_ro, 3},
  272:              {quod_ledger_store, fold, 5}, {quod_ledger_store, fold_groups, 3},
  273:              {quod_ledger_store, batch_sync, 1}, {file, datasync, 1}],
  274:     lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> 1 = erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, true, [local]) end, Calls),
  275:     1 = erlang:trace(Owner, true, [call, set_on_spawn, {tracer, self()}]),
  276:     try
  277:         {ok, A} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  278:         {ok, B} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  279:         ?assertEqual(maps:get(slot, A), maps:get(slot, B)),
  280:         Barrier = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
  281:         receive {trace_delivered, all, Barrier} -> ok after 5000 -> error(trace_timeout) end,
  282:         Events = enrollment_evidence_events([]),
  283:         {ok, SelfKey} = application:get_env(quod, node_pubkey),
  284:         Probes = lists:usort([Pid || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence,
  285:             [_, _, Peer, _, I | _]}} <- Events, Peer =:= SelfKey, I =:= Identity]),
  286:         ?assert(length(Probes) >= 1),
  287:         ?assertEqual(2, length([ok || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity,
  288:             [_, I, _]}} <- Events, Pid =:= Owner, I =:= Identity])),
  289:         Reads = [MFA || {Pid, MFA} <- Events, lists:member(Pid, Probes)],
  290:         ?assertEqual(length(Probes), length([ok || {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, _} <- Reads])),
  291:         ?assertEqual([], [MFA || {_, {M, F, _} = MFA} <- Events,
  292:             M =/= quod_foreign_log, {M, F} =/= {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot}]),
  293:         #{checks => 2, slot => maps:get(slot, B), local_probes => length(Probes),
  294:           archive_rebuilds_or_writes => 0}
  295:     after
  296:         erlang:trace(Owner, false, [call, set_on_spawn]),
  297:         lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, false, [local]) end, Calls)
  298:     end.
  299: 
  300: enrollment_evidence_events(Acc) ->
  301:     receive {trace, Pid, call, MFA} -> enrollment_evidence_events([{Pid, MFA} | Acc])
  302:     after 0 -> Acc end.
  303: 
  304: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After) ->
  305:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}),
  306:     try enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, quod_time:mono_ms() + 15000)
  307:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}) end.
  308: 
  309: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline) ->
  310:     case ets:lookup(quod_directory_highwater, Author) of
  311:         [{Author, Epoch, Number}] when {Epoch, Number} > After; After =:= none ->
  312:             {ok, {Epoch, Number}};
  313:         _ -> receive
  314:             {node_identity_route_changed, _, Ref} ->
  315:                 enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline)
  316:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  317:             error({generation_not_received, Author, After, quod_directory_control:stats()})
  318:         end
  319:     end.
  320: 
  321: enrollment_wait_complete() ->
  322:     Manager = quod_reg:where({namespace_manager, node}), Parent = self(),
  323:     Observer = fun(State, {in, {node_enrollment_result, _, Result}}, _) ->
  324:                        Parent ! {enrollment_progress, Result}, State;
  325:                   (State, _, _) -> State end,
  326:     ok = sys:install(Manager, {Observer, enrollment_test}),
  327:     try
  328:         ok = quod_namespace_manager:enroll_node(),
  329:         enrollment_wait_complete(quod_time:mono_ms() + 45000)
  330:     after sys:remove(Manager, Observer) end.
  331: 
  332: enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline) ->
  333:     case maps:get(node_enrollment, quod_namespace_manager:stats()) of
  334:         complete -> ok;
  335:         {error, Reason} -> error({enrollment_failed, Reason});
  336:         _ -> receive
  337:             {enrollment_progress, _} -> enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline)
  338:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  339:             error({enrollment_incomplete, quod_namespace_manager:stats()})
  340:         end
  341:     end.
  342: 
  343: %% These suite peers retain directory high-water marks across cases. Advance
  344: %% the synthetic author's epoch even when a preceding recovery case expired
  345: %% all its routes; never weaken the directory's stale-generation rejection.
  346: enrollment_route(Peer, Key, Endpoint, Hosted) ->
  347:     Author = {root_bootstrap, Key, Key},
  348:     Previous = peer:call(Peer, ets, lookup, [quod_directory_highwater, Author]),
  349:     Epoch = case Previous of [] -> 1; [{Author, E, _}] -> E + 1 end,
  350:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  351:                         [Key, Endpoint, Hosted, Epoch, 1]),
  352:     ok.
  353: 
  354: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal) ->
  355:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime, Ns}),
  356:     try enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000)
  357:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime, Ns}) end.
  358: 
  359: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline) ->
  360:     case quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, Goal) of
  361:         {ok, [_], _} -> ok;
  362:         _ -> receive
  363:             {proof_ready, {Ns, _}, _, _, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline);
  364:             {replay_ready, {Ns, _}, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline)
  365:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) -> error({enrollment_not_ready, Ns})
  366:         end
  367:     end.
  368: 
  369: remote_signed_transaction_savepoints(Config) ->
  370:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  371:     %% Fresh callable names cannot be made accidentally executable by a
  372:     %% previously loaded test beam or another proof's atom allocation.
  373:     Suffix = integer_to_binary(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
  374:     Removed = <<"tx_wire_removed_", Suffix/binary>>,
  375:     Kept = <<"tx_wire_kept_", Suffix/binary>>,
  376:     LocalChoices = <<"tx_wire_local_choices_", Suffix/binary>>,
  377:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(assertz(", LocalChoices,
  378:       "(0)), assertz((", LocalChoices, "(N) :- N > 0, M is N - 1, "
  379:       "((assertz(", Removed, "(N)), fail); \\+ ", Removed, "(N)), ",
  380:       LocalChoices, "(M))))."]),
  381:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
  382:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
  383:     Failed = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(transaction((assertz(", Removed,
  384:       "(1)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(1)), fail)); true)."]),
  385:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
  386:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Failed)),
  387:     Fallback = iolist_to_binary(["animals::transaction((third::true, ",
  388:       LocalChoices, "(1200), ((assertz(", Removed,
  389:       "(2)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(2)), fail); (assertz(", Kept,
  390:       "(3)), ", LocalChoices, "(1200), third::assertz(", Kept, "(3))))))."]),
  391:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  392:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Fallback)),
  393:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  394:         RemoveAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Removed, utf8]),
  395:         KeepAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Kept, utf8]),
  396:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {RemoveAtom, {'X'}}])),
  397:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {KeepAtom, 3}]))
  398:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  399: 
  400: cut_findall_local_and_cohosted(Config) ->
  401:     Peer = ?config(target, Config),
  402:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  403:     lists:foreach(fun(Inner) ->
  404:         Goal = {findall, X, {';', {',', Inner, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, {'L'}},
  405:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [1]}], _},
  406:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Goal], 60000))
  407:     end, [Choices, {'::', ?FOURTH_NS, Choices}]).
  408: 
  409: cut_findall_remote_boundaries(Config) ->
  410:     Peer = ?config(asker, Config),
  411:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  412:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, Choices},
  413:     Cases = [
  414:       {{';', Remote, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 2, 3]},
  415:       {{';', {'::', ?NS, {',', Choices, '!'}}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  416:       {{';', {',', Remote, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1]},
  417:       {{';', {',', {'::', ?NS, {'\\+', {',', '!', fail}}}, {'=', X, 1}},
  418:                {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  419:       {{'::', ?NS, {';', {'->', {',', '!', fail}, {'=', X, 1}},
  420:                               {'=', X, 2}}}, [2]}],
  421:     lists:foreach(fun({Inner, Expected}) ->
  422:         Goal = {findall, X, Inner, {'L'}},
  423:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := Expected}], _},
  424:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000))
  425:     end, Cases).
  426: 
  427: cut_findall_signed_multiscope_savepoints(Config) ->
  428:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  429:     %% Genuine signed requests and target commits, not an intent or overlay
  430:     %% shortcut. Ordinary collection retains staged writes; transaction
  431:     %% checkpoints remove failed-candidate writes on both remote scopes.
  432:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  433:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
  434:         <<"animals::findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_keep(X)), third::assertz(cut_keep(X)), !), [1]).">>)),
  435:     Rollback = submit_signed_execute(Config,
  436:         <<"animals::((transaction((findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_remove(X)), third::assertz(cut_remove(X)), !), [1]), fail))); X=rolled_back).">>),
  437:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}}, Rollback),
  438:     {ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [RollbackBinding]}}} = Rollback,
  439:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, rolled_back}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(RollbackBinding)),
  440:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  441:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 1}])),
  442:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 2}])),
  443:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_remove, {'X'}}]))
  444:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  445: 
  446: init_per_suite(Config) ->
  447:     {TargetPub, _} = TargetKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  448:     {AskerPub, _} = AskerKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  449:     {ThirdPub, _} = ThirdKey = key_before(TargetPub),
  450:     {AgentPub, _} = AgentKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  451:     TargetAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?TARGET_PORT},
  452:     AskerAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  453:     ThirdAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?THIRD_PORT},
  454:     Animals = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/animals.pl"),
  455:     Pets = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/pets.pl"),
  456:     {ok, AnimalsBin} = file:read_file(Animals),
  457:     {ok, PetsBin} = file:read_file(Pets),
  458:     FilterSymbolName =
  459:         <<"quod_r4_target_only_",
  460:           (binary:encode_hex(crypto:strong_rand_bytes(8)))/binary>>,
  461:     TargetGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_animals.pl"),
  462:     ok = file:write_file(
  463:            TargetGenesis,
  464:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, "
  465:             "human_user(test_agent)), _Chain, _Ns).\n",
  466:             AnimalsBin,
  467:             "\necho(X).\n",
  468:             FilterSymbolName, "(opaque).\n",
  469:             "blocked(X) :- fail_with_reason(impossible_to_link(X)).\n",
  470:             "via_third_failure :- third::third_blocked.\n",
  471:             "via_fourth(X) :- third::via_fourth(X).\n",
  472:             "dtx_write_chain(X) :- assertz(dtx_animals_mark(X)), "
  473:             "third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  474:             dtx_disjoint_target_rules(),
  475:             "conflict_version(0).\n"
  476:             "dtx_conflicting_write(X) :- conflict_version(_), "
  477:             "retract(conflict_version(0)), assertz(conflict_version(X)), "
  478:             "assertz(dtx_conflict_mark(X)), third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  479:             deep_failure_rules(),
  480:             "loop :- loop.\n"]),
  481:     TargetAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  482:                     ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub]},
  483:     Target = start_node(target, ?TARGET_PORT, TargetKey, ?NS,
  484:                         TargetGenesis, [], TargetAllow, Config),
  485:     ThirdGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_third.pl"),
  486:     ok = file:write_file(
  487:            ThirdGenesis,
  488:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  489:             "third_blocked :- fail_with_reason(third_declined).\n"
  490:             "via_fourth(X) :- fourth::leaf(X).\n"
  491:             "dtx_write(X) :- assertz(dtx_third_mark(X)).\n",
  492:             dtx_disjoint_third_rules()]),
  493:     ThirdAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  494:                    ?NS => [TargetPub]},
  495:     Third = start_node(third, ?THIRD_PORT, ThirdKey, ?THIRD_NS,
  496:                        ThirdGenesis, [], ThirdAllow, Config),
  497:     FourthGenesis = filename:join(
  498:                       ?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_fourth.pl"),
  499:     ok = file:write_file(
  500:            FourthGenesis,
  501:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  502:             "leaf(ok).\n"]),
  503:     start_namespace(
  504:       Target, TargetPub, ?FOURTH_NS, FourthGenesis, [], Config),
  505:     PrivateGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_private.pl"),
  506:     %% Policy belongs in GENESIS. `can_invoke/4` gates every scope entry —
  507:     %% including a top-level prove on this node — so an ontology born without a
  508:     %% clause could never be given one: it would deny the very proof that would
  509:     %% assert its policy. An empty chain is this host's own entry, which is
  510:     %% allowed so the ontology is usable at all; the restrictive clauses for
  511:     %% remote callers are asserted through it below.
  512:     ok = file:write_file(
  513:            PrivateGenesis,
  514:            ["can_join(_Ns, _Addr, Pk) :- peer_ready(Pk).\n",
  515:             "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, [], _Ns).\n",
  516:             "secret(42).\n"
  517:             "hidden(99).\n"]),
  518:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?PRIVATE_NS, PrivateGenesis, [], Config),
  519:     start_root_namespace(Target, TargetPub, Config),
  520:     start_brahms(Target, ?NS, TargetAddr, []),
  521:     DirectoryAllow = #{?NS => [ThirdPub, TargetPub],
  522:                        ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub],
  523:                        ?ROOT_NS => [TargetPub]},
  524:     AskerGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_pets.pl"),
  525:     AgentKeySource = prolog_binary_literal(AgentPub),
  526:     ok = file:write_file(
  527:            AskerGenesis,
  528:            ["agent_key(human_user(test_agent), ", AgentKeySource,
  529:             ", active).\n",
  530:             %% Only a goal which also writes A is locally authorized here.
  531:             %% Exact remote selectors deliberately have no matching A policy;
  532:             %% the target ontology alone must authorize its predicate.
  533:             "can_invoke((assertz(signed_pets_mark(_)), _), "
  534:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  535:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  536:             "can_invoke((instance_of(pet, my_dog), _), "
  537:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  538:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  539:             "can_invoke(independent(_), "
  540:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  541:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n"
  542:             "can_invoke((_;_), "
  543:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  544:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  545:             PetsBin,
  546:             "\nrecover_third_failure :- animals::via_third_failure ; "
  547:             "get_fail_reasons([_, _, _, _, third_declined]).\n"]),
  548:     Asker = start_node(asker, ?ASKER_PORT, AskerKey, ?ASKER_NS,
  549:                        AskerGenesis,
  550:                        [TargetAddr], DirectoryAllow, Config),
  551:     TargetAnchor = peer:call(
  552:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  553:     ThirdAnchor = peer:call(
  554:                     Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS]),
  555:     FourthAnchor = peer:call(
  556:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]),
  557:     AskerAnchor = peer:call(
  558:                      Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ASKER_NS]),
  559:     RootAnchor = peer:call(
  560:                    Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ROOT_NS]),
  561:     NetworkId = RootAnchor,
  562:     lists:foreach(
  563:       fun(Peer) -> set_network_identity(Peer, NetworkId) end,
  564:       [Target, Asker, Third]),
  565:     %% Root's seed/spec requires a local replica before durable effects.
  566:     %% The old fixture declared its anchor as locally desired on every peer
  567:     %% but left Asker/Third without the corresponding owner. R2 correctly
  568:     %% treats that as unavailable local history, never as foreign permission.
  569:     %% Pin the refusal, then establish real non-voting replicas. Root writes
  570:     %% and effect custody still execute on Target, its sole validator.
  571:     start_brahms(Target, ?ROOT_NS, TargetAddr, []),
  572:     lists:foreach(fun({RootPeer, RootPub, RootAddr}) ->
  573:         ?assertEqual(undefined,
  574:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ROOT_NS}])),
  575:         RootDeadline = peer:call(RootPeer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 1000,
  576:         ?assertEqual({error, not_ready}, peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex,
  577:             history_view_at, [{?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor}, 1, RootDeadline])),
  578:         start_join_namespace(RootPeer, RootPub, ?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  579:         start_brahms(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, RootAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  580:         wait_ready(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, {effect_custody_limits, 64, unlimited}),
  581:         ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},
  582:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS]))
  583:     end, [{Asker, AskerPub, AskerAddr}, {Third, ThirdPub, ThirdAddr}]),
  584:     %% The third node is a real, fully synchronized observer of `animals`.
  585:     %% Its key sorts before the sole validator so the live selection tests
  586:     %% below would choose it first if advertised roles were trusted.
  587:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_quic, learn, [TargetPub, TargetAddr]),
  588:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_quic, learn, [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr]),
  589:     start_join_namespace(
  590:       Third, ThirdPub, ?NS, TargetAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  591:     start_brahms(Third, ?NS, ThirdAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  592:     AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor,
  593:                 {human_user, test_agent}},
  594:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  595:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  596:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  597:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator},
  598:                   {?FOURTH_NS, FourthAnchor, validator},
  599:                   {?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  600:     %% Start with the controller-relay topology. Atomic commit cases establish
  601:     %% B's C route explicitly: Resolve verifies every role's certified Vote,
  602:     %% not just the origin's. Scope selection itself remains owned by A.
  603:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  604:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  605:                 [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr,
  606:                  [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  607:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}], 1, 1]),
  608:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  609:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  610:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  611:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  612:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  613:                 Target, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  614:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  615:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  616:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  617:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  618:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  619:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  620:     %% Private reachability is the local projection of an exact committed
  621:     %% HostNodeRef.  The target ontology's public route supplies that host's
  622:     %% current endpoint; the private ontology itself is never advertised.
  623:     PrivateAnchor = peer:call(
  624:                       Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
  625:     HostNodeRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, TargetAnchor, target_node},
  626:     ok = peer:call(
  627:            Asker, quod_directory, install_private_projection,
  628:            [[#{namespace => ?PRIVATE_NS, anchor => PrivateAnchor,
  629:                host_node_ref => HostNodeRef}]]),
  630:     %% The origin, not the currently executing B scope, selects C for A→B→C.
  631:     %% B therefore has no C route; this exercises the authenticated controller
  632:     %% relay and target-only atom materialization path.
  633:     %% C was installed above through the same candidate path.
  634:     start_brahms(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  635:     start_brahms(Third, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAddr, []),
  636:     %% Root's ordinary Prolog policy, not the transport fixture, grants this
  637:     %% exact durable agent permission to create an ontology.  The signed
  638:     %% remote-effect case below must still pass Root's normal can_invoke and
  639:     %% can_create_ontology rules.
  640:     ?assertMatch(
  641:        {ok, [_], _},
  642:        peer:call(
  643:          Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  644:          [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creator_agent, AgentRef}}],
  645:          60000)),
  646:     AuthPid = peer:call(Asker, erlang, whereis, [quod_client_auth]),
  647:     true = is_pid(AuthPid),
  648:     ClientPeer = {127, 0, 0, 1},
  649:     Session = open_client_session(
  650:                 Asker, NetworkId, AskerPub, AgentKey, ClientPeer),
  651:     wait_ready(Target, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  652:     wait_ready(Third, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  653:     wait_ready(Target, ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, 42}),
  654:     wait_ready(Third, ?THIRD_NS,
  655:                {can_invoke, probe, anonymous, [], ?THIRD_NS}),
  656:     wait_ready(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {instance_of, pet, my_dog}),
  657:     %% `can_invoke/4` receives the authenticated principal and the whole
  658:     %% origin-built chain at once, so a restrictive policy names both itself.
  659:     %% `secret/1` admits the real node key; `hidden/1` deliberately names a
  660:     %% different one, so the negative case still proves that an ontology name
  661:     %% in the chain cannot launder its transport.
  662:     ACLs = [
  663:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {secret, {'X'}}, {node, AskerPub},
  664:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}},
  665:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {hidden, {'X'}}, {node, <<0:256>>},
  666:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}}
  667:     ],
  668:     lists:foreach(
  669:       fun(ACL) ->
  670:           ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _},
  671:                        peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  672:                                  [?PRIVATE_NS, ACL], 60000))
  673:       end, ACLs),
  674:     [{target, Target}, {asker, Asker}, {third, Third},
  675:      {target_pub, TargetPub}, {asker_pub, AskerPub},
  676:      {target_addr, TargetAddr}, {third_pub, ThirdPub},
  677:      {third_addr, ThirdAddr}, {network_id, NetworkId},
  678:      {target_anchor, TargetAnchor}, {third_anchor, ThirdAnchor},
  679:      {fourth_anchor, FourthAnchor},
  680:      {asker_anchor, AskerAnchor}, {filter_symbol_name, FilterSymbolName},
  681:      {agent_ref, AgentRef},
  682:      {agent_key, AgentKey}, {agent_pub, AgentPub},
  683:      {client_peer, ClientPeer}, {client_session, Session},
  684:      {client_auth, AuthPid} | Config].
  685: 
  686: end_per_suite(Config) ->
  687:     _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || P <- [?config(target, Config),
  688:                                       ?config(asker, Config),
  689:                                       ?config(third, Config)]],
  690:     ok.
  691: 
  692: %% A real, caught-up observer can answer the ontology locally, but an
  693: %% advertised observer row is never eligible to answer a single-host remote
  694: %% read. The sole current validator must own the live scope.
  695: remote_plain_read_excludes_live_observer(Config) ->
  696:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  697:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  698:     Observer = ?config(third, Config),
  699:     ObserverKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  700:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  701:     ?assert(lists:any(
  702:               fun(#{node_key := Key, role := observer}) ->
  703:                       Key =:= ObserverKey;
  704:                  (_) -> false
  705:               end, Routes)),
  706:     ?assertMatch(
  707:        {ok, [_], _},
  708:        peer:call(Observer, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  709:                  [?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}], 5000)),
  710:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  711:     AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  712:     assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Observer),
  713:     ?assertEqual(
  714:        AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  715:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)).
  716: 
  717: %% Native preparation needs the selected physical host, including an observer.
  718: %% It uses the ordinary authenticated scope wire, in an isolated read-only
  719: %% context; it cannot supply ordinary material reads or execute the signed goal.
  720: remote_native_read_uses_selected_observer(Config) ->
  721:     Asker = ?config(asker,Config), Observer = ?config(third,Config),
  722:     Key = ?config(third_pub,Config), Identity = {?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config)},
  723:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},peer:call(Observer,quod_simplex,status,[?NS])),
  724:     {Bytes,Signature} = signed_goal_request(?config(network_id,Config),
  725:         ?config(agent_pub,Config),?config(agent_key,Config),?ASKER_NS,
  726:         ?config(asker_anchor,Config),quod_time:now_ms()+30000,execute,
  727:         <<"assertz(signed_pets_mark(987654321)).">>),
  728:     {ok,Evidence} = quod_client_goal:verify(Bytes,Signature),
  729:     Auth = quod_client_goal:request_auth(Evidence),
  730:     Read = fun(Target,Goal) ->
  731:         Deadline = peer:call(Asker,quod_time,mono_ms,[]) + 10000,
  732:         peer:call(Asker,quod_ask,native_read,[Key,Target,Goal,Auth,Deadline],15000)
  733:     end,
  734:     ?assertEqual({ok,{current_executor_key,Key}},Read(Identity,{current_executor_key,Key})),
  735:     Operation = maps:get(operation_ref,Evidence),
  736:     ?assertEqual({ok,{current_request_operation,Operation}},Read(Identity,{current_request_operation,Operation})),
  737:     ?assertEqual({ok,{via_fourth,ok}},Read(Identity,{via_fourth,ok})),
  738:     ?assertMatch({error,_},Read(Identity,{assertz,native_scope_write})),
  739:     ?assertMatch({error,_},Read({?NS,<<0:256>>},true)),
  740:     ?assertMatch({fail,_},peer:call(Observer,quod_prolog,prove_ro,[?NS,native_scope_write])),
  741:     assert_fact_absent(Asker,?ASKER_NS,signed_pets_mark,987654321).
  742: 
  743: %% The same live observer now lies in its next signed directory generation and
  744: %% labels itself a validator. Its key sorts before the real validator, so a
  745: %% role-trusting selector would open the scope there. The certified target
  746: %% committee removes it and resolution reaches the honest coexisting route.
  747: remote_plain_read_rejects_lying_validator(Config) ->
  748:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  749:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  750:     Liar = ?config(third, Config),
  751:     LiarKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  752:     LiarEndpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
  753:     TargetKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  754:     TargetAnchor = ?config(target_anchor, Config),
  755:     ThirdAnchor = ?config(third_anchor, Config),
  756:     LyingRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  757:                  {?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}],
  758:     HonestRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  759:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}],
  760:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  761:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  762:                 [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, LyingRows, 1, 2]),
  763:     try
  764:         {known, Routes} = peer:call(
  765:                             Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  766:         ValidatorKeys = [Key || #{role := validator, node_key := Key} <- Routes],
  767:         ?assertEqual([LiarKey, TargetKey], ValidatorKeys),
  768:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  769:         AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  770:         assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Liar),
  771:         ?assertEqual(
  772:            AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  773:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config))
  774:     after
  775:         {ok, _} = peer:call(
  776:                     Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  777:                     [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, HonestRows, 1, 3])
  778:     end.
  779: 
  780: assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Validator, RefusedHost) ->
  781:     wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 200),
  782:     wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200),
  783:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
  784:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
  785:                        [quod_prolog, prove_ro, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
  786:     try
  787:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 1, 1500),
  788:         ?assertEqual(0, scope_worker_count(RefusedHost))
  789:     after
  790:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
  791:         wait_engine_stat(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, proof_workers, 0, 500),
  792:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 500),
  793:         wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200)
  794:     end.
  795: 
  796: scope_worker_count(Peer) ->
  797:     maps:get(scope_workers,
  798:              peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [?NS]), undefined).
  799: 
  800: assert_symbol_opaque(Peer, SymbolName) ->
  801:     ?assertEqual(
  802:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
  803:        peer:call(Peer, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
  804: 
  805: remote_scope_solutions(Config) ->
  806:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  807:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, {'D'}}},
  808:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _},
  809:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000)),
  810:     All = {findall, {'D'}, Goal, {'L'}},
  811:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [{'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>},
  812:                                   {'$quod_symbol', <<"meat">>}]}], _},
  813:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, All], 60000)).
  814: 
  815: remote_scope_trace_parentage(Config) ->
  816:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  817:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  818:     %% These peers use standard_io, not Erlang distribution to the CT VM.
  819:     %% All trace collection and monitoring stay on the owning peer; neither
  820:     %% target loads this suite's intentionally caller-only vocabulary.
  821:     Collector = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, start, []),
  822:     try
  823:         {Result, Public, Open, Directory, ScopeOpen, Request} = peer:call(
  824:                                                                  Asker,
  825:                                                                  quod_trace_fixture,
  826:                                                                  prove,
  827:                                                                  [?ASKER_NS,
  828:                                                                   {'::', ?NS,
  829:                                                                    {diet, dog,
  830:                                                                     {'D'}}}],
  831:                                                                  60000),
  832:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _}, Result),
  833:         ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Open#span.trace_id),
  834:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Directory#span.parent_span_id),
  835:         ?assertEqual(Directory#span.span_id, ScopeOpen#span.parent_span_id),
  836:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Request#span.parent_span_id),
  837:         Auth = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
  838:                          [Collector, <<"quod.scope.authenticate">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
  839:         InvokeOpen = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
  840:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_open">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
  841:         InvokeNext = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
  842:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_next">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
  843:         %% These spans are emitted by the actual remote authentication worker
  844:         %% and target invocation worker, not by a codec-only fixture.
  845:         lists:foreach(fun(Span) ->
  846:             ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Span#span.trace_id),
  847:             ?assertEqual(ScopeOpen#span.span_id, Span#span.parent_span_id),
  848:             ?assert(Span#span.parent_span_is_remote),
  849:             ?assert(Span#span.end_time >= Span#span.start_time)
  850:         end, [Auth, InvokeOpen, InvokeNext])
  851:     after
  852:         ok = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, stop, [Collector])
  853:     end.
  854: 
  855: remote_scope_symbol_safety(Config) ->
  856:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  857:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  858:     Echo = {'::', ?NS, {echo, asker_only_symbol}},
  859:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
  860:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  861:                            [?ASKER_NS, Echo], 60000)),
  862:     ?assertEqual({ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"asker_only_symbol">>}},
  863:                  peer:call(Target, quod_wire_term, decode,
  864:                            [{0, <<"asker_only_symbol">>}])),
  865:     Unknown = {'::', ?NS, {asker_only_predicate, x}},
  866:     ?assertMatch({fail, [_ | _]},
  867:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  868:                            [?ASKER_NS, Unknown], 60000)).
  869: 
  870: %% A retains the new predicate as an opaque symbol. C alone starts with its
  871: %% fact. B materializes the spelling from a deliberately failing local branch
  872: %% while leaving C's nested goal opaque, then C returns that same symbol. Both
  873: %% simultaneous first-use requests must bind without a failed seed request.
  874: remote_signed_fresh_nested_symbol(Config) ->
  875:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  876:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
  877:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
  878:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
  879:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
  880:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
  881:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
  882:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
  883:     RaceSuffix = integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
  884:     RacePredicateText = "quod_fresh_race_" ++ RaceSuffix,
  885:     RacePredicate = list_to_atom(RacePredicateText),
  886:     ?assertMatch(
  887:        {ok, [_], _},
  888:        peer:call(
  889:          Third, quod_prolog, prove,
  890:          [?THIRD_NS, {assertz, {RacePredicate, ok}}], 60000)),
  891:     RaceGoalText = iolist_to_binary(
  892:                      ["\"animals\"::((", RacePredicateText,
  893:                       "(ok), fail); \"third\"::", RacePredicateText,
  894:                       "(ok))."]),
  895:     Requests =
  896:         [signed_goal_request(
  897:            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
  898:            maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read, RaceGoalText)
  899:          || _ <- [first, second]],
  900:     Parent = self(),
  901:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
  902:     Workers =
  903:         [spawn(
  904:            fun() ->
  905:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
  906:                Parent !
  907:                    {RaceRef, Label,
  908:                     peer:call(
  909:                       Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
  910:                       [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes,
  911:                        RequestSignature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
  912:            end)
  913:          || {Label, {Bytes, RequestSignature}} <-
  914:                 lists:zip([first, second], Requests)],
  915:     lists:foreach(fun(Worker) -> Worker ! {RaceRef, go} end, Workers),
  916:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
  917:     lists:foreach(
  918:       fun({_Label,
  919:            {ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _Height, [_Answer]}}}}}) -> ok;
  920:          ({Label, Other}) -> error({fresh_symbol_race_failed, Label, Other})
  921:       end, Results).
  922: 
  923: remote_scope_chain_policy(Config) ->
  924:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  925:     Allowed = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, {'X'}}},
  926:     ?assertMatch(
  927:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
  928:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  929:                  [?ASKER_NS, Allowed], 60000)),
  930:     %% A refusal crosses QUIC as ordinary logical failure carrying its bounded
  931:     %% reason, so the caller can inspect it and branch — same contract as the
  932:     %% co-hosted path.
  933:     Denied = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {hidden, {'X'}}},
  934:     {fail, DeniedReasons} =
  935:         peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  936:                   [?ASKER_NS, Denied], 60000),
  937:     ?assert(lists:member({not_allowed, ?PRIVATE_NS}, DeniedReasons)),
  938:     ?assertMatch(
  939:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
  940:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  941:                  [?ASKER_NS, {';', Denied, Allowed}], 60000)),
  942:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(
  943:                         Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
  944:     ?assert(Routes =/= []),
  945:     ?assert(lists:all(
  946:               fun(#{scope := private, status := confirmed}) -> true;
  947:                  (_) -> false
  948:               end, Routes)),
  949:     ?assertEqual([], peer:call(
  950:                        Asker, quod_directory, directory_hosts,
  951:                        [?PRIVATE_NS])).
  952: 
  953: remote_scope_failure_reasons(Config) ->
  954:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  955:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {blocked, bob}},
  956:     Recover = {';', Remote,
  957:                {get_fail_reasons,
  958:                 [{'Outer'}, {blocked, bob}, {impossible_to_link, bob}]}},
  959:     ?assertMatch(
  960:        {ok, [#{'Outer' := Remote}], _},
  961:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  962:                  [?ASKER_NS, Recover], 60000)).
  963: 
  964: %% The C predicate name is compiled only on B/C. A relays it without allocating
  965: %% an atom; C materializes it after authenticating the scoped command. A's
  966: %% declared recovery rule then matches C's reason after it returns through B.
  967: remote_scope_nested_failure_reasons(Config) ->
  968:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  969:     ?assertMatch(
  970:        {ok, [#{}], _},
  971:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  972:                  [?ASKER_NS, recover_third_failure], 60000)),
  973:     ?assertEqual(
  974:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"third_blocked">>}},
  975:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
  976:                  [{0, <<"third_blocked">>}])),
  977:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
  978:       Asker, ?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS,
  979:       ?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
  980:       <<"third_blocked">>).
  981: 
  982: remote_scope_deep_failure_reasons(Config) ->
  983:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  984:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {deep_failure, 70}},
  985:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
  986:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
  987:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
  988:     ?assert(length(Reasons) > 64),
  989:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
  990:     ?assertEqual({'$quod_symbol', <<"deep_bottom">>}, lists:last(Reasons)),
  991:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
  992:       Asker, ?config(target, Config), ?NS,
  993:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
  994:       <<"deep_bottom">>).
  995: 
  996: assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
  997:   Asker, Host, Ns, HostKey, Endpoint, SymbolName) ->
  998:     Anchor = peer:call(Host, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
  999:     ?assertMatch(
 1000:        {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}}},
 1001:        peer:call(
 1002:          Asker, quod_foreign_log, current,
 1003:          [[{HostKey, [Endpoint]}], {Ns, Anchor}, 20000], 25000)),
 1004:     %% current/3 must be able to certify and retain the complete foreign
 1005:     %% history without interning that ontology's application vocabulary.
 1006:     ?assertEqual(
 1007:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
 1008:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
 1009: 
 1010: remote_scope_structural_reason_truncation(Config) ->
 1011:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1012:     %% A deep value at the wire boundary must survive intact.  This makes the
 1013:     %% over-depth assertion below non-vacuous: the recursive builder really is
 1014:     %% compiled and its binding crosses the remote proof boundary.
 1015:     Legal = {'::', ?NS, bounded_reason},
 1016:     {fail, LegalReasons} = peer:call(
 1017:                              Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1018:                              [?ASKER_NS, Legal], 60000),
 1019:     {ok, Bottom} = peer:call(
 1020:                      Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1021:                      [{0, <<"deep_bottom">>}]),
 1022:     LegalReason = lists:foldl(
 1023:                     fun(_, Acc) -> [Acc] end, Bottom,
 1024:                     lists:seq(1, 63)),
 1025:     ?assert(lists:member(LegalReason, LegalReasons)),
 1026:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(LegalReasons)),
 1027: 
 1028:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, deep_reason},
 1029:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1030:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1031:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1032:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1033:     ?assert(lists:member(deep_reason, Reasons)),
 1034:     ?assert(lists:member(fail_reasons_truncated, Reasons)),
 1035:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(Reasons)).
 1036: 
 1037: remote_scope_cancel(Config) ->
 1038:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1039:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1040:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1041:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1042:                        [quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1043:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 1, 200),
 1044:     true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1045:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
 1046: 
 1047: %% Scope commands share the bounded node-level router without sharing proof
 1048: %% state. Two full waves prove that completed scopes release every target worker
 1049: %% and leave the transport reusable for independent proofs.
 1050: remote_scope_transport_reuse(Config) ->
 1051:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1052:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1053:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}},
 1054:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, first),
 1055:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200),
 1056:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, second),
 1057:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
 1058: 
 1059: %% The browser is logged into A as an agent stored in A. Exact selectors reach
 1060: %% B through the ordinary scope path. A has no ACL clause for these goals, so
 1061: %% success proves that A authenticates identity while B alone authorizes B's
 1062: %% predicate.
 1063: remote_signed_gateway_read_execute_cursor(Config) ->
 1064:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1065:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1066:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1067:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1068:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1069:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1070:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1071:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1072: 
 1073:     {ReadBytes, ReadSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1074:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1075:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1076:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read,
 1077:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1078:     {ok, ReadEvidence,
 1079:      {normalized, {read, ReadDependencies, {answers, ReadHeight, ReadBlobs}}}} =
 1080:         peer:call(
 1081:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1082:           [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), ReadBytes, ReadSignature, Peer],
 1083:           60000),
 1084:     ?assertEqual({?ASKER_NS,AgentAnchor,ReadHeight},
 1085:         lists:keyfind(?ASKER_NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1086:     ?assertEqual({?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),
 1087:                   peer:call(?config(target,Config),quod_prolog,applied,[?NS])},
 1088:         lists:keyfind(?NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1089:     ?assertEqual(ReadBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, ReadEvidence)),
 1090:     ?assertEqual(ReadSignature, maps:get(signature, ReadEvidence)),
 1091:     ?assertEqual(
 1092:        [[{<<"D">>, kibble}]],
 1093:        [begin {ok, Binding} = quod_durable_term:decode_result(Blob), Binding end
 1094:         || Blob <- ReadBlobs]),
 1095:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1096:     ExecuteText = iolist_to_binary(
 1097:                     io_lib:format("assertz(gateway_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1098:     {ExecuteBytes, ExecuteSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1099:                                          NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1100:                                          ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1101:                                          maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1102:                                          execute,
 1103:                                          <<"\"animals\"::", ExecuteText/binary>>),
 1104:     {ok, ExecuteEvidence,
 1105:      {normalized,
 1106:       {committed, [_],
 1107:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = ExecuteTargetRef}}} =
 1108:         peer:call(
 1109:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1110:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), ExecuteBytes,
 1111:            ExecuteSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1112:     ?assertEqual(
 1113:        ExecuteTargetRef,
 1114:        completed_remote_operation(
 1115:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, ExecuteEvidence), 600)),
 1116:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_mark, Tag),
 1117: 
 1118:     CursorText =
 1119:         <<"\"animals\"::(diet(dog, D), assertz(gateway_choice(D))).">>,
 1120:     {CursorBytes, CursorSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1121:                                        NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1122:                                        ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1123:                                        maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1124:                                        cursor, CursorText),
 1125:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1126:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, FirstBlob}}} =
 1127:         peer:call(
 1128:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1129:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorBytes,
 1130:            CursorSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1131:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, kibble}]},
 1132:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(FirstBlob)),
 1133:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1134:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, SecondBlob}}} =
 1135:         peer:call(
 1136:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1137:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, next, Peer], 60000),
 1138:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, meat}]},
 1139:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(SecondBlob)),
 1140:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1141:      {normalized,
 1142:       {committed, [_],
 1143:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = CursorTargetRef}}} =
 1144:         peer:call(
 1145:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1146:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, accept, Peer], 60000),
 1147:     ?assertEqual(
 1148:        CursorTargetRef,
 1149:        completed_remote_operation(
 1150:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, CursorEvidence), 600)),
 1151:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_choice, meat),
 1152: 
 1153:     {StopBytes, StopSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1154:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1155:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1156:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor,
 1157:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1158:     {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, StopCursor, _, _}}} =
 1159:         peer:call(
 1160:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1161:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), StopBytes,
 1162:            StopSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1163:     ?assertMatch(
 1164:        {ok, _, {normalized, stopped}},
 1165:        peer:call(
 1166:          Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1167:          [maps:get(session_id, Session), StopCursor, stop, Peer], 60000)).
 1168: 
 1169: %% B contributes only a certified read. C remains the sole writer, so this is
 1170: %% one ordinary remote operation claim and target transaction, never a DTX
 1171: %% group with an empty source Vote/Resolve role for B.
 1172: remote_signed_read_certified_write(Config) ->
 1173:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1174:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1175:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1176:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1177:                  io_lib:format(
 1178:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), "
 1179:                    "\"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1180:     {ok, Evidence,
 1181:      {normalized,
 1182:       {committed, [_],
 1183:        {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, _} = TargetRef}}} =
 1184:         submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText),
 1185:     ?assertEqual(
 1186:        ThirdAnchor,
 1187:        peer:call(Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS])),
 1188:     ?assertEqual(
 1189:        TargetRef,
 1190:        completed_remote_operation(
 1191:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1192:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1193: 
 1194: %% R4-UNCERTAIN-CLAIM-DELIVERY-01: this is a real signed operation admitted
 1195: %% through the ordinary client, source consensus, and remote target. Once it
 1196: %% is accepted, deliver the SAME durable claim twice more through the real
 1197: %% endpoint. Only the transport correlation id changes. No hand-built claim,
 1198: %% new signed goal, new application identity, or admission bypass is used.
 1199: remote_exact_claim_redelivery(Config) ->
 1200:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1201:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1202:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1203:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1204:              "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1205:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_],
 1206:         {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, Anchor, TxId} = TargetRef}}} =
 1207:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1208:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1209:     ?assertEqual(TargetRef, completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600)),
 1210:     {ok, #{height := ClaimSlot}} = peer:call(
 1211:         Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, OperationRef]),
 1212:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1213:     {ok, CertifiedClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(
 1214:         Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1215:         [?ASKER_NS, ClaimSlot, OperationRef, Deadline]),
 1216:     {ok, ClaimBytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim),
 1217:     Target = {?THIRD_NS, Anchor},
 1218:     StableClaimRef = quod_transaction:stable_ref(CertifiedClaimRef),
 1219:     ?assertMatch(#transaction{tx_id = TxId},
 1220:         quod_transaction:remote_application(StableClaimRef, Claim, Target)),
 1221:     Before = peer:call(Third, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences,
 1222:                        [?THIRD_NS, TxId]),
 1223:     ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1224:     lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1225:         ?assertEqual({ok, ClaimBytes},
 1226:                      quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim)),
 1227:         RequestId = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 1228:         Request = {apply_claim, RequestId, Target, ClaimBytes},
 1229:         {ok, {application, RequestId, committed, ApplicationBytes} = Response,
 1230:          _Hints} =
 1231:             peer:call(Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1232:                       [?ASKER_NS, Target, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000),
 1233:         ?assert(quod_dtx_endpoint:correlates(Request, Response)),
 1234:         {ok, ApplicationRef, #transaction{tx_id = TxId,
 1235:             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}}} =
 1236:             quod_transaction:decode_evidence(ApplicationBytes),
 1237:         ?assertEqual(TargetRef, quod_transaction:stable_ref(ApplicationRef)),
 1238:         ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Third, ?MODULE,
 1239:             claim_application_occurrences, [?THIRD_NS, TxId])),
 1240:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag)
 1241:     end, [first_redelivery, second_redelivery]).
 1242: 
 1243: %% Test-side audit only, executed ON the target. An ordinary immutable owner
 1244: %% snapshot is read without returning any store or interpreter state to the
 1245: %% caller. Count ledger occurrences as well as visible facts: an extra inert
 1246: %% or rejected envelope must not hide a second application under the same id.
 1247: claim_application_occurrences(Ns, TxId) ->
 1248:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1249:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1250:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1251:     try
 1252:         lists:reverse(quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1253:             fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1254:                 case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1255:                     #entry{index = Slot, data = {batch, Transactions}} ->
 1256:                         [Slot || #transaction{tx_id = Id,
 1257:                             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}} <- Transactions,
 1258:                             Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1259:                     _ -> Acc
 1260:                 end
 1261:             end, []))
 1262:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1263:     end.
 1264: 
 1265: %% A writes locally while B contributes only a certified read. The result is
 1266: %% A's ordinary transaction; there is no source claim and no DTX group.
 1267: local_write_with_foreign_read(Config) ->
 1268:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1269:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1270:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1271:                  io_lib:format(
 1272:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1273:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1274:     ?assertMatch(
 1275:        {ok, _,
 1276:         {normalized,
 1277:          {committed, [_], {transaction, ?ASKER_NS, _, _}}}},
 1278:        submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)),
 1279:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1280: 
 1281: %% The read token is sealed first. B then commits another diet/2 fact before
 1282: %% its validators sign the certificate. Certification must reject the stale
 1283: %% token and A's local write must remain absent.
 1284: read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1285:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1286:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1287:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1288:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1289:                  io_lib:format(
 1290:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1291:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1292:     ok = peer:call(
 1293:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1294:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1295:     Parent = self(),
 1296:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1297:     _ = spawn(
 1298:           fun() ->
 1299:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1300:           end),
 1301:     try
 1302:         ok = peer:call(
 1303:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1304:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1305:         ?assertMatch(
 1306:            {ok, [_], _},
 1307:            peer:call(
 1308:              Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1309:              [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {stale_marker, Tag}}}],
 1310:              60000))
 1311:     after
 1312:         %% Never leave the TEST-only rendezvous installed if an assertion
 1313:         %% above fails: a later proof would otherwise correctly wait forever.
 1314:         _ = peer:call(
 1315:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1316:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1317:     end,
 1318:     Result = receive
 1319:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1320:              after 60000 ->
 1321:                  ct:fail(stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1322:              end,
 1323:     ?assertMatch(
 1324:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1325:     assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1326: 
 1327: %% The signed claim lane treats A's own read exactly like any other read-only
 1328: %% dependency. If A changes after sealing but before certification, neither the
 1329: %% source claim nor C's write may be submitted.
 1330: remote_signed_origin_read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1331:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1332:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1333:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1334:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1335:                  io_lib:format(
 1336:                    "instance_of(pet, my_dog), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).",
 1337:                    [Tag])),
 1338:     ok = peer:call(
 1339:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1340:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1341:     Parent = self(),
 1342:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1343:     _ = spawn(
 1344:           fun() ->
 1345:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1346:           end),
 1347:     try
 1348:         ok = peer:call(
 1349:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1350:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1351:         %% The source proof is deliberately parked before its certificate.
 1352:         %% Commit the intervening source-head change at the consensus seam so
 1353:         %% this test does not depend on a second client ingress being admitted
 1354:         %% while the first signed request still owns that ingress session.
 1355:         append_source_marker(Config, Tag)
 1356:     after
 1357:         _ = peer:call(
 1358:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1359:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1360:     end,
 1361:     Result = receive
 1362:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1363:              after 60000 ->
 1364:                  ct:fail(origin_stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1365:              end,
 1366:     ?assertMatch(
 1367:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1368:     assert_fact_absent(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1369: 
 1370: %% Two independent gateways race the same signed execute. One may receive a
 1371: %% typed pre-custody availability refusal while the other proof is sealing;
 1372: %% the stable operation claim must still give both gateways one durable result
 1373: %% and one material write.
 1374: remote_signed_two_gateway_race(Config) ->
 1375:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1376:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1377:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1378:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1379:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1380:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1381:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1382:     AskerSession = open_client_session(
 1383:                      Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1384:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1385:     ThirdSession = open_client_session(
 1386:                      Third, NetworkId, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1387:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1388:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1389:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1390:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1391:                  io_lib:format(
 1392:                    "\"animals\"::assertz(gateway_race_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1393:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, AskerSession),
 1394:                   maps:get(expires_ms, ThirdSession)),
 1395:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1396:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1397:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1398:                                   Expires, execute, GoalText),
 1399:     Parent = self(),
 1400:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1401:     _ = spawn(
 1402:           fun() ->
 1403:               Parent !
 1404:                 {RaceRef, asker,
 1405:                  peer:call(
 1406:                    Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1407:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession),
 1408:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1409:           end),
 1410:     _ = spawn(
 1411:           fun() ->
 1412:               Parent !
 1413:                 {RaceRef, third,
 1414:                  peer:call(
 1415:                    Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1416:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession),
 1417:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1418:           end),
 1419:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1420:     Classified = [classify_race_submit(Result)
 1421:                   || {_Gateway, Result} <- Results],
 1422:     Evidences = [Ev || {accepted, Ev} <- Classified],
 1423:     %% A simultaneous second proof may be refused before durable custody while
 1424:     %% the first proof is still sealing. That refusal is safe because both
 1425:     %% gateways retain the exact same signed request and operation reference;
 1426:     %% after the first claim commits, either gateway must resolve it.
 1427:     ?assert(Evidences =/= []),
 1428:     [Evidence | _] = Evidences,
 1429:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1430:     lists:foreach(
 1431:       fun(Ev) ->
 1432:           ?assertEqual(OperationRef, maps:get(operation_ref, Ev)),
 1433:           ?assertEqual(RequestBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, Ev)),
 1434:           ?assertEqual(Signature, maps:get(signature, Ev))
 1435:       end, Evidences),
 1436:     OutcomeRef = {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} =
 1437:         completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1438:     ?assertEqual(
 1439:        TargetAnchor,
 1440:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS])),
 1441:     ?assertMatch(
 1442:        {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 1443:               outcome_ref := {applications, [{transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _}]}}},
 1444:        peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
 1445:     ?assertMatch(
 1446:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1447:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1448:                 #{status := completed,
 1449:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1450:        wait_remote_operation(
 1451:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession), RequestBytes,
 1452:          Signature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 1453:     {ok, #{status := committed, height := OutcomeHeight, ref := OutcomeRef}} =
 1454:         peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]),
 1455:     %% Third is an observer of the target ontology. A remote result at Asker
 1456:     %% does not mean Third's local projection has consumed the target block.
 1457:     %% Wait for that actual event; do not resubmit, nudge the feed, or replace
 1458:     %% the fixture's ordering requirement with a short repeated resolve loop.
 1459:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_ct, await_applied,
 1460:                    [?NS, OutcomeHeight, 10000], 15000),
 1461:     ?assertMatch(
 1462:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1463:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1464:                 #{status := completed,
 1465:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1466:        peer:call(
 1467:          Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1468:          [maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession), RequestBytes,
 1469:           Signature, ClientPeer], 10000)),
 1470:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_race_mark, Tag).
 1471: 
 1472: %% A signed agent stored in A reaches B and then C through the same nested
 1473: %% scope and group machinery. No specialized client or agent executor exists.
 1474: %% Real signed proofs use the same action evaluator locally at animals, on
 1475: %% its co-hosted fourth namespace, and remotely at third. The first candidate
 1476: %% crosses both boundaries, stages facts/events, cuts and fails. Only the
 1477: %% complete second candidate may reach any target ledger.
 1478: independent_action_multiscope_rollback(Config) ->
 1479:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1480:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1481:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1482:       "animals::(assertz((action_bad(~B) :- "
 1483:       "assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B)), "
 1484:       "fourth::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), "
 1485:       "third::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), !, fail)), "
 1486:       "assertz((action_good(~B) :- assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B)), "
 1487:       "fourth::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))), "
 1488:       "third::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))))), "
 1489:       "assertz(action(action_bad(~B), [], action_done(~B))), "
 1490:       "assertz(action(action_good(~B), [], action_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(18, Tag))),
 1491:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1492:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1493:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, Rows}}}} =
 1494:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1495:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1496:     ?assertEqual([?NS, ?FOURTH_NS, ?THIRD_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1497:     Owners = #{?NS => ?config(target, Config), ?FOURTH_NS => ?config(target, Config),
 1498:                ?THIRD_NS => ?config(third, Config)},
 1499:     lists:foreach(fun({{Ns, _}, {committed, {transaction, Ns, _, Id}}}) ->
 1500:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1501:         assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, action_done, Tag),
 1502:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_leak, Tag),
 1503:         Changes = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, action_application_changes, [Ns, Id]),
 1504:         ?assertEqual([{action_done, Tag}], [E || {event, E} <- Changes])
 1505:     end, Rows).
 1506: 
 1507: independent_action_remote_errors(Config) ->
 1508:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1509:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1510:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1511:       "animals::(assertz((action_error(~B) :- assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), "
 1512:       "third::(assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), assertz(true)))), "
 1513:       "assertz(action(action_error(~B), [], action_error_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(5, Tag))),
 1514:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1515:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_error_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1516:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1517:     Capture = peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, start_action_error_capture, []),
 1518:     {Result, Errors} = try
 1519:         {submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1520:          peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture])}
 1521:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
 1522:         peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture]),
 1523:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
 1524:     end,
 1525:     %% Public normalization deliberately hides language descriptors. Pin the
 1526:     %% original error at the real worker return, then the unchanged public form.
 1527:     ?assert(lists:member({permission_error, modify, static_procedure, {'/', true, 0}}, Errors)),
 1528:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, proof_unavailable}}}, Result),
 1529:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 1530:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_error_leak, Tag)
 1531:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
 1532: 
 1533: start_action_error_capture() ->
 1534:     Pid = spawn(fun() -> action_error_capture([], none) end),
 1535:     1 = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, [{'_', [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
 1536:     _ = erlang:trace(all, true, [call, {tracer, Pid}]),
 1537:     Pid.
 1538: 
 1539: finish_action_error_capture(Pid) ->
 1540:     _ = erlang:trace(all, false, [call]),
 1541:     _ = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, false, [local]),
 1542:     Ref = make_ref(), Pid ! {finish, self(), Ref},
 1543:     receive {Ref, Errors} -> Errors after 5000 -> erlang:error(action_trace_timeout) end.
 1544: 
 1545: action_error_capture(Errors, Closing) ->
 1546:     receive
 1547:         {trace, _, return_from, {quod_proof_scope, next, 1},
 1548:          {error, {erlog, Reason}, _, _}} ->
 1549:             true = length(Errors) < 16,
 1550:             action_error_capture([Reason | Errors], Closing);
 1551:         {finish, Caller, Ref} ->
 1552:             Delivery = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
 1553:             action_error_capture(Errors, {Caller, Ref, Delivery});
 1554:         {trace_delivered, all, Delivery} ->
 1555:             {Caller, Ref, Delivery} = Closing, Caller ! {Ref, Errors};
 1556:         _ -> action_error_capture(Errors, Closing)
 1557:     end.
 1558: 
 1559: action_application_changes(Ns, TxId) ->
 1560:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1561:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1562:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1563:     try
 1564:         [Changes] = quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1565:           fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1566:               case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1567:                   #entry{data = {batch, Txs}} ->
 1568:                       [Diff || #transaction{tx_id = Id, diff = Diff} <- Txs,
 1569:                                Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1570:                   _ -> Acc
 1571:               end
 1572:           end, []),
 1573:         Changes
 1574:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1575:     end.
 1576: 
 1577: %% Root's governed create_ontology bridge uses the same action evaluator and
 1578: %% its private savepoint. The other target writes ordinary facts; Root remains
 1579: %% effect-only, and exact durable claim redelivery cannot repeat the effect.
 1580: independent_action_remote_prepared_rollback(Config) ->
 1581:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1582:     Discarded = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-discarded-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1583:     Kept = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-kept-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1584:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1585:       "(assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1586:       "assertz((action_effect_bad(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), !, fail)), "
 1587:       "assertz((action_effect_good(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), assertz(action_effect_done(~B)))), "
 1588:       "assertz(action(action_effect_bad(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B))), "
 1589:       "assertz(action(action_effect_good(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B)))).",
 1590:       [Tag, Tag, Discarded, Tag, Kept, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag])),
 1591:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1592:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("independent(goal(action_effect_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1593:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1594:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1595:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1596:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1597:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1598:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])),
 1599:     ?assertEqual({ok, ready}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Kept])),
 1600:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, action_effect_done, Tag),
 1601:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1602:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])).
 1603: 
 1604: remote_independent_root_effect(Config) ->
 1605:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1606:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1607:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:s8-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1608:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1609:       "independent((assertz(s8_effect_mark(~B)), "
 1610:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 1611:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 1612:       "s8_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor))).", [Tag, CreatedNs])),
 1613:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1614:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1615:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1616:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1617:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1618:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1619:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {s8_effect_created, ok}),
 1620:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs]),
 1621:     ?assertMatch(<<_:256>>, Anchor),
 1622:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1623:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs])),
 1624:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1625:     #{included := Receipt} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ct, await_operation_complete,
 1626:                                       [?ASKER_NS, Op, 5000], 10000),
 1627:     ?assert(quod_operation_vector:certified(Receipt)).

 1629: remote_independent_routes(Config) ->
 1630:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1631:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1632:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
 1633:       submit_signed_execute(Config, <<"animals::independent(true).">>)),
 1634:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1635:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1636:       "animals::independent(assertz(s6_remote(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1637:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], Ref}}} =
 1638:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1639:     ?assertMatch({transaction, ?NS, _, _}, Ref),
 1640:     ?assertEqual(Ref, completed_remote_operation(
 1641:                        Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1642:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, s6_remote, Tag),
 1643:     lists:foreach(fun(Goal) ->
 1644:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1645:                      submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal))
 1646:     end, [<<"independent((assertz(s6_ab), animals::assertz(s6_ab))).">>,
 1647:           <<"animals::independent((assertz(s6_bc), third::assertz(s6_bc))).">>]),
 1648:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns, Fact}) ->
 1649:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Fact]))
 1650:     end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s6_ab}, {Target, ?NS, s6_ab},
 1651:           {Target, ?NS, s6_bc}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_bc}]).
