 1653: %% L2-S8-DEFERRED-7.4-ADMITTED-PARTIAL-OUTCOME: both plans are genuinely
 1654: %% sealed, then one target's read becomes stale before claim admission. The
 1655: %% shared applier rejects ONLY that target. No hand-built claim or bypass.
 1656: remote_independent_partial_outcome(Config) ->
 1657:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1658:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1659:     Third = ?config(third, Config), Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1660:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1661:       "animals::independent((diet(dog, kibble), assertz(s8_rejected(~B)), third::dtx_write(~B))).",
 1662:       [Tag, Tag])),
 1663:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1664:     Parent = self(), RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1665:     _ = spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal)} end),
 1666:     try
 1667:         ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1668:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1669:           [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {s8_stale_marker, Tag}}}], 60000))
 1670:     after
 1671:         _ = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1672:     end,
 1673:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1674:         receive {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1675:         after 60000 -> ct:fail(independent_partial_outcome_timeout) end,
 1676:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1677:     ?assertEqual(mixed, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1678:     ?assertMatch([{{?NS, _}, {{rejected, conflict_retry}, _}},
 1679:                   {{?THIRD_NS, _}, {committed, _}}], Rows),
 1680:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1681:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1682:     %% Repeat exact delivery after mixed completion: rejected A stays rejected,
 1683:     %% committed B stays exactly once, and neither gets a fresh application id.
 1684:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?NS => Target, ?THIRD_NS => Third}),
 1685:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1686:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1687:     %% The source owner must recover the same complete vector for a later
 1688:     %% caller. A different gateway then verifies the source receipt and the
 1689:     %% exact AM3 target evidence; current-view status labels are insufficient.
 1690:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, ?config(client_session, Config)),
 1691:     RequestBytes = maps:get(request_bytes, Evidence), Signature = maps:get(signature, Evidence),
 1692:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1693:       peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1694:         [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 10000)),
 1695:     ForeignSession = open_client_session(Target, ?config(network_id, Config),
 1696:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config), ?config(client_peer, Config)),
 1697:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1698:       wait_remote_operation(Target, maps:get(session_id, ForeignSession), RequestBytes,
 1699:         Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config), 8)).

 1702: assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, Owners) ->
 1703:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1704:     {ok, #{height := Slot}} = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, Op]),
 1705:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1706:     {ok, ClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1707:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Slot, Op, Deadline]),
 1708:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim),
 1709:     lists:foreach(fun({Identity = {Ns, _}, {Verdict, Ref}}) ->
 1710:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1711:         {transaction, _, _, TxId} = Ref,
 1712:         Before = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]),
 1713:         ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1714:         lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1715:             ?assertEqual({ok, Bytes}, quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim)),
 1716:             Id = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), Request = {apply_claim, Id, Identity, Bytes},
 1717:             ?assertMatch({ok, {application, Id, Verdict, _}, _Hints}, peer:call(
 1718:               Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1719:               [?ASKER_NS, Identity, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000)),
 1720:             ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]))
 1721:         end, [first, second])
 1722:     end, Rows).
 1723: 
 1724: %% Positive atomic/reconnect cases establish their own route precondition. A prior
 1725: %% case may already have installed this exact fixture route; verify it then,
 1726: %% never erase it or rely on a particular suite order. Negative/recovery
 1727: %% route cases use the separately isolated read-set suite.
 1728: require_third_route_at_target(Config) ->
 1729:     Peer = ?config(target, Config), Key = ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1730:     Endpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1731:     Identity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 1732:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]) of
 1733:         {error, unavailable} ->
 1734:             {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 1735:               [Key, Endpoint, [{?THIRD_NS, element(2, Identity), validator}], 1, 1]);
 1736:         {ok, _} -> ok
 1737:     end,
 1738:     {ok, Routes} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]),
 1739:     {Key, Endpoints} = lists:keyfind(Key, 1, Routes),
 1740:     ?assert(lists:member(Endpoint, Endpoints)),
 1741:     ok.

 1743: remote_independent_branch_provenance(Config) ->
 1744:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1745:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1746:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1747:     %% The original signed request and real sealed retained writes choose L3.
 1748:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1749:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1750:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f1), third::assertz(s6_f1), fail))); true).">>)),
 1751:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 1752:                  peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f1])),
 1753:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f1])),
 1754:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, independent_mixed_writes}}},
 1755:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1756:         <<"animals::(((assertz(s6_f2), fail); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f2))).">>)),
 1757:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1758:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1759:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f3), fail)); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f3))).">>)),
 1760:     %% A remotely-produced successful marker must unwind at its caller too.
 1761:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1762:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1763:         <<"((animals::independent((assertz(s6_unwound), third::assertz(s6_unwound))), fail); true).">>)),
 1764:     lists:foreach(fun(Fact) ->
 1765:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Fact])),
 1766:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, Fact]))
 1767:     end, [s6_f2]),
 1768:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f3])),
 1769:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f3])).

 1790: remote_independent_cursor_selects_only_accepted_answer(Config) ->
 1791:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1792:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1793:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1794:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1795:     lists:foreach(fun(AcceptSecond) ->
 1796:         Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1797:         Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1798:           "animals::((independent((assertz(s6_cursor(~B)), third::assertz(s6_cursor(~B)))), X=first); X=second).",
 1799:           [Tag, Tag])),
 1800:         {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1801:           ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1802:           ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor, Text),
 1803:         {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, First}}} = peer:call(
 1804:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1805:           [cursor, SessionId, Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1806:         ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, first}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(First)),
 1807:         case AcceptSecond of
 1808:             false -> ok;
 1809:             true ->
 1810:                 {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, Second}}} = peer:call(
 1811:                   Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1812:                   [SessionId, CursorId, next, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1813:                 ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, second}]},
 1814:                              quod_durable_term:decode_result(Second))
 1815:         end,
 1816:         Result = peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1817:                           [SessionId, CursorId, accept, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1818:         case AcceptSecond of
 1819:             false ->
 1820:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1821:                              {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}}, Result),
 1822:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1823:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag);
 1824:             true ->
 1825:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1826:                                      {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}}, Result),
 1827:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1828:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag)
 1829:         end
 1830:     end, [false, true]).

 1832: remote_signed_gateway_group(Config) ->
 1833:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1834:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1835:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1836:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1837:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1838:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1839:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1840:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1841: 
 1842:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1843:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1844:     %% Third already received Target's exact current record in suite setup.
 1845:     %% Reinstalling sequence 1 here would correctly be rejected as stale.
 1846:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1847:     GroupText = iolist_to_binary(
 1848:                   io_lib:format(
 1849:                     "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).", [Tag])),
 1850:     {GroupBytes, GroupSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1851:                                      NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1852:                                      ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1853:                                      maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 1854:                                      GroupText),
 1855:     {ok, GroupEvidence,
 1856:      {normalized,
 1857:       {committed, [_],
 1858:        {group_outcome,
 1859:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 1860:         _, Slots}}}} =
 1861:         peer:call(
 1862:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1863:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), GroupBytes,
 1864:            GroupSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1865:     %% O participates even when both writable scopes are remote.
 1866:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 1867:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 1868:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1869:     ?assertMatch(
 1870:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 1871:        peer:call(
 1872:          Asker, quod_prolog, outcome,
 1873:          [maps:get(operation_ref, GroupEvidence)])),
 1874:     ok.
 1875: 
 1876: %% Eight independently signed, non-conflicting A -> B -> C writes enter
 1877: %% together. Each writes distinct predicate heads on B and C, so this exercises
 1878: %% the conflict-safe batch path rather than the separate wait-die abort test
 1879: %% below. The old single handoff slot rejected this shape as busy.
 1880: remote_signed_concurrent_gateway_groups(Config) ->
 1881:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1882:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1883:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1884:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1885:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1886:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1887:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1888:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1889:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1890:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1891:     PredicateRows = dtx_disjoint_predicates(),
 1892:     Requests =
 1893:         [begin
 1894:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1895:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1896:                           io_lib:format(
 1897:                             "\"animals\"::~s(~B).",
 1898:                             [atom_to_list(ChainPredicate), Tag])),
 1899:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1900:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1901:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1902:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1903:                                            execute, GoalText),
 1904:              {Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 1905:               RequestBytes, Signature}
 1906:          end || {Index, {ChainPredicate, LocalPredicate,
 1907:                          _RemoteWriter, RemotePredicate}} <-
 1908:                     lists:zip(lists:seq(1, 8), PredicateRows)],
 1909:     Parent = self(),
 1910:     ConcurrentRef = make_ref(),
 1911:     Writers =
 1912:         [spawn(
 1913:            fun() ->
 1914:                receive {ConcurrentRef, go} -> ok end,
 1915:                Result = peer:call(
 1916:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1917:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1918:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1919:                Parent ! {ConcurrentRef, Index, Result}
 1920:            end)
 1921:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 1922:              RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 1923:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {ConcurrentRef, go} end, Writers),
 1924:     Results = collect_gateway_race(ConcurrentRef, length(Requests), []),
 1925:     EvidenceByIndex =
 1926:         maps:from_list(
 1927:           [{Index, concurrent_submit_evidence(Index, Result)}
 1928:            || {Index, Result} <- Results]),
 1929:     OperationRefs =
 1930:         [maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex))
 1931:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 1932:              _RequestBytes, _Signature} <- Requests],
 1933:     ?assertEqual(length(Requests), length(lists:usort(OperationRefs))),
 1934:     lists:foreach(
 1935:       fun({Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 1936:            _RequestBytes, _Signature}) ->
 1937:           OperationRef = maps:get(
 1938:                            operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex)),
 1939:           {#{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef},
 1940:            #{status := committed, participant_slots := Slots}} =
 1941:               wait_operation_claim(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1942:           ?assertMatch(
 1943:              {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _}, GroupRef),
 1944:           ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 1945:           assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, LocalPredicate, Tag),
 1946:           assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, RemotePredicate, Tag)
 1947:       end, Requests),
 1948:     Stats = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS]),
 1949:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_waiting, Stats)),
 1950:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_dormant, Stats)),
 1951:     ok.
 1952: 
 1953: %% Both proofs read conflict_version/1 while it is zero, then wait at the
 1954: %% pre-Vote FIFO seam. One group changes that fact; the other must retain its
 1955: %% claimed operation id and terminate with the ordinary stale-read abort.
 1956: remote_signed_queued_occ_abort(Config) ->
 1957:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1958:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1959:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1960:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1961:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1962:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1963:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1964:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1965:     Session = open_client_session(
 1966:                 Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1967:                 AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1968:     Requests =
 1969:         [begin
 1970:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1971:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1972:                           io_lib:format(
 1973:                             "\"animals\"::dtx_conflicting_write(~B).",
 1974:                             [Tag])),
 1975:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1976:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1977:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1978:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1979:                                            execute, GoalText),
 1980:              {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature}
 1981:          end || Index <- [1, 2]],
 1982:     Parent = self(),
 1983:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1984:     Writers =
 1985:         [spawn(
 1986:            fun() ->
 1987:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 1988:                Result = peer:call(
 1989:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1990:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1991:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1992:                Parent ! {RaceRef, Index, Result}
 1993:            end)
 1994:          || {Index, _Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 1995:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {RaceRef, go} end, Writers),
 1996:     Evidences = maps:from_list(
 1997:                   [{Index, concurrent_conflict_evidence(Index, Result)}
 1998:                    || {Index, Result} <-
 1999:                           collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, [])]),
 2000:     Outcomes =
 2001:         [{Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2002:           wait_operation_terminal(
 2003:             Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, Evidences)), 600)}
 2004:          || {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2005:     [{CommittedIndex, CommittedTag, _CommittedBytes, _CommittedSignature,
 2006:       {_, #{status := committed}}}] =
 2007:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _, {_, #{status := committed}}} <- Outcomes],
 2008:     [{AbortedIndex, AbortedTag, AbortedBytes, AbortedSignature,
 2009:       {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}}] =
 2010:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _,
 2011:                        {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}} <- Outcomes],
 2012:     ?assertNotEqual(CommittedIndex, AbortedIndex),
 2013:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, CommittedTag),
 2014:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, AbortedTag),
 2015:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, CommittedTag),
 2016:     ?assertMatch(
 2017:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 2018:                 #{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}},
 2019:        wait_remote_operation(
 2020:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, Session), AbortedBytes,
 2021:          AbortedSignature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 2022:     ok.
 2023: 
 2024: %% One signed proof writes its agent ontology and stages Root's existing
 2025: %% create-ontology effect.  Root is hosted on another peer, so this exercises
 2026: %% the real scope custody command, not only the co-hosted session path.
 2027: remote_signed_gateway_group_with_root_effect(Config) ->
 2028:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2029:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2030:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2031:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2032:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2033:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2034:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2035:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2036:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2037:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(
 2038:                   ["ct:remote-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2039:     GoalText = root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs),
 2040:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2041:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2042:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2043:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2044:                                   GoalText),
 2045:     {ok, _Evidence,
 2046:      {normalized,
 2047:       {committed, [_],
 2048:        {group_outcome,
 2049:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2050:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2051:         peer:call(
 2052:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2053:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), RequestBytes,
 2054:            Signature, Peer], 60000),
 2055:     ?assertEqual(2, length(Slots)),
 2056:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2057:     %% Group application records the effect obligation; the existing effect
 2058:     %% owner starts the ontology asynchronously. Observe its completion before
 2059:     %% asking the new ontology to prove a goal.
 2060:     wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, applied, 300),
 2061:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {remote_effect_created, ok}),
 2062:     ok.
 2063: 
 2064: root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs) ->
 2065:     iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 2066:       "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2067:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 2068:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 2069:       "remote_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor).", [Tag, CreatedNs])).
 2070: 
 2071: %% A real remote effect is durably bound, but the source never activates.
 2072: %% OTP's installed debug callback holds the existing activation call before
 2073: %% handle_call, without a production hook or a send/receipt ordering guess.
 2074: remote_bound_effect_recovers_without_activation(Config) ->
 2075:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2076:     OldEngine = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2077:     OldSimplex = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2078:     Gate = {?MODULE, before_activation},
 2079:     ok = peer:call(Asker, sys, install,
 2080:                    [OldEngine, {Gate, fun ?MODULE:hold_group_activation/3, armed}]),
 2081:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2082:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:aborted-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2083:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2084:     %% Choose the request's original bound once; never extend it after failure.
 2085:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, Session), quod_time:now_ms() + 10000),
 2086:     {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2087:       ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2088:       ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), Expires, execute,
 2089:       root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs)),
 2090:     Parent = self(), CallRef = make_ref(), ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2091:     spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {CallRef, peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2092:       submit, [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)} end),
 2093:     try
 2094:         {GroupRef, _Token} = wait_activation_gate(Asker, CallRef, 300),
 2095:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, group_pending, 50),
 2096:         {running, OwnerState} = peer:call(Asker, sys, get_state, [OldSimplex]),
 2097:         ?assertMatch(#{active := 0, reserved := 1}, peer:call(
 2098:           Asker, quod_simplex, test_dtx_admission_state, [OwnerState])),
 2099:         Journal = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, test_signing_journal, [OwnerState]),
 2100:         {group, _, _, _, _, Id} = GroupRef,
 2101:         #{Id := #{sequence := 0, envelope := none,
 2102:                   material := {{quod_dtx_vote, 4, Group, _, none, _}, _, _}}} =
 2103:             peer:call(Asker, quod_signing_journal, pending_dtx, [Journal]),
 2104:         %% Source responsibility already retains the exact original request,
 2105:         %% before activation or any source Vote. It is not just a generated
 2106:         %% operation ID that a later hosted incarnation would have to recreate.
 2107:         Digest = crypto:hash(sha256,Bytes),
 2108:         ?assertMatch({quod_atomic_group,4,_,{agent_goal_v1,Digest,Bytes,Signature},_},Group),
 2109:         {ok,#{request := #{evidence := #{agent_ref_blob := AgentBytes}}}} =
 2110:             peer:call(Asker,quod_atomic,group_binding,[Group]),
 2111:         ?assertEqual(#{Id => true},peer:call(Asker,?MODULE,agent_custody_snapshot,[OldSimplex,AgentBytes])),
 2112:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldEngine, kill]),
 2113:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2114:         receive {CallRef, Result} ->
 2115:             ?assertNotMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
 2116:         after 10000 -> ct:fail(bound_effect_caller_did_not_observe_crash)
 2117:         end,
 2118:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2119:         ?assertMatch(#{status := aborted, ref := GroupRef},
 2120:                      wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600)),
 2121:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, retired, 300),
 2122:         assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2123:         ?assertEqual(undefined, peer:call(Target, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, CreatedNs}])),
 2124:         assert_dtx_released(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2125:         assert_dtx_released(Target, ?ROOT_NS)
 2126:     after
 2127:         %% Release only this test gate if setup failed before the injected kill.
 2128:         case peer:call(Asker, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2129:             {ok, {_Ref, Release}} -> peer:call(Asker, erlang, send, [OldEngine, {release, Release}]);
 2130:             _ -> ok
 2131:         end,
 2132:         _ = catch peer:call(Asker, sys, remove, [OldEngine, Gate]),
 2133:         _ = peer:call(Asker, application, unset_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate])
 2134:     end.
 2135: 
 2136: agent_custody_snapshot(Owner, Agent) ->
 2137:     Token = make_ref(), Monitor = monitor(process,Owner),
 2138:     Owner ! {agent_work_custody,self(),Token,Agent,all},
 2139:     try receive
 2140:         {agent_work_custody,Owner,Token,Rows} -> Rows;
 2141:         {'DOWN',Monitor,process,Owner,Reason} -> error({custody_owner_down,Reason})
 2142:     after 5000 -> error(custody_snapshot_missing)
 2143:     end after demonitor(Monitor,[flush]) end.
 2144: 
 2145: hold_group_activation(armed, {in, {'$gen_call', _, {activate_dtx_vote, _, GroupRef}}}, _) ->
 2146:     Token = make_ref(),
 2147:     ok = application:set_env(quod, ct_activation_gate, {GroupRef, Token}),
 2148:     receive {release, Token} -> ok after 15000 -> ok end,
 2149:     done;
 2150: hold_group_activation(State, _Event, _Name) -> State.
 2151: 
 2152: wait_activation_gate(_Peer, _CallRef, 0) -> ct:fail(activation_gate_timeout);
 2153: wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries) ->
 2154:     case peer:call(Peer, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2155:         {ok, {_, _} = Held} -> Held;
 2156:         _ ->
 2157:             receive {CallRef, Result} -> ct:fail({proof_ended_before_activation, Result})
 2158:             after 20 -> wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries - 1)
 2159:             end
 2160:     end.
 2161: 
 2162: %% One browser-equivalent request crosses two remote scope hops and commits
 2163: %% through the ordinary group protocol.
 2164: remote_signed_group_uses_exact_agent_request(Config) ->
 2165:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2166:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2167:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2168:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2169:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2170:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2171:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2172:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2173:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2174:                  io_lib:format(
 2175:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2176:                    "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).",
 2177:                    [Tag, Tag])),
 2178:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2179:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2180:                                   ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2181:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), GoalText),
 2182:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, SubmitResult}} = peer:call(
 2183:                                                    Asker,
 2184:                                                    quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2185:                                                    submit,
 2186:                                                    [execute,
 2187:                                                     maps:get(session_id,
 2188:                                                              Session),
 2189:                                                     RequestBytes, Signature,
 2190:                                                     Peer],
 2191:                                                    60000),
 2192:     {GroupRef, Outcome} =
 2193:         case SubmitResult of
 2194:             {committed, [_],
 2195:              {group_outcome,
 2196:               {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref,
 2197:               Height, ParticipantSlots}} ->
 2198:                 {Ref, #{status => committed, ref => Ref, height => Height,
 2199:                         participant_slots => ParticipantSlots}};
 2200:             {pending, {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref} ->
 2201:                 %% A transport timeout is uncertainty, never permission to
 2202:                 %% resubmit. Resolve the exact first group instead.
 2203:                 {Ref, wait_group_outcome(Asker, Ref, 600)}
 2204:         end,
 2205:     Slots = maps:get(participant_slots, Outcome),
 2206:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2207:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2208:     assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2209:     assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2210:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 2211:     ?assertMatch(
 2212:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2213:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])).
 2214: 
 2215: %% The origin is stopped after the remote Vote wave, before any Resolve.
 2216: %% Recovery uses certified own-role material, never a re-proof or another
 2217: %% role's plan. The exact caller reference still finds the one terminal result.
 2218: remote_group_recovers_after_origin_crash(Config) ->
 2219:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2220:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2221:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2222:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2223:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2224:     Goal = {',', {assertz, {dtx_pets_mark, Tag}},
 2225:                  {'::', ?NS, {dtx_write_chain, Tag}}},
 2226:     VotePhase = {voted, {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)}},
 2227:     ok = peer:call(
 2228:            Asker, application, set_env,
 2229:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier, {hold, VotePhase}]),
 2230:     ?assertEqual(
 2231:        {ok, {hold, VotePhase}},
 2232:        peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2233:                  [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2234:     Parent = self(),
 2235:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2236:     _ProofCaller = spawn(
 2237:                      fun() ->
 2238:                          Result = peer:call(
 2239:                                     Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 2240:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000),
 2241:                          Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2242:                      end),
 2243:     try
 2244:         GroupId = wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, VotePhase, Config),
 2245:         %% No role has applied; each one's exact positive Vote must already
 2246:         %% be certified, making commit the only possible recovered outcome.
 2247:         lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 2248:             assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId),
 2249:             assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId)
 2250:         end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]),
 2251:         {ok, {?ASKER_NS, Anchor, Coordinator, Admission}} =
 2252:             peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, dtx_binding, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2253:         GroupRef = {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2254:                     Coordinator, Admission, GroupId},
 2255:         OldSimplex = peer:call(
 2256:                        Asker, quod_reg, where,
 2257:                        [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2258:         true = is_pid(OldSimplex),
 2259:         %% The bounded test valve must still be holding the coordinator at
 2260:         %% the Vote wave. Otherwise a slow test could silently crash after a
 2261:         %% self-released gate and prove only a weaker recovery path.
 2262:         ?assertMatch(
 2263:            {ok, {held, GroupId, VotePhase, _}},
 2264:            peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2265:                      [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2266:         %% Disable the one-shot barrier before restart: the replacement
 2267:         %% coordinator must be free to rediscover the Votes and continue.
 2268:         ok = peer:call(
 2269:                Asker, application, unset_env,
 2270:                [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]),
 2271:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2272:         ?assertEqual(
 2273:            {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}},
 2274:            receive
 2275:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2276:            after 10000 ->
 2277:                ct:fail(proof_caller_did_not_observe_origin_crash)
 2278:            end),
 2279:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2280:         Outcome = wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600),
 2281:         ?assertMatch(
 2282:            #{status := committed, ref := GroupRef,
 2283:              participant_slots := [_, _, _]}, Outcome),
 2284:         assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, dtx_pets_mark, Tag),
 2285:         assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2286:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2287:         lists:foreach(
 2288:           fun({Peer, Ns}) -> assert_dtx_released(Peer, Ns) end,
 2289:           [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}])
 2290:     after
 2291:         _ = peer:call(
 2292:               Asker, application, unset_env,
 2293:               [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])
 2294:     end.
 2295: 
 2296: %% A route consumer knows the certified identities but starts with no live
 2297: %% route rows.  Each missing hop parks on the one exact directory property;
 2298: %% installing the ordinary complete generation wakes that same proof.  Four
 2299: %% ontology scopes are involved even though B and D share one physical node.
 2300: remote_four_scope_chain_recovers_empty_routes(Config) ->
 2301:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2302:     TargetIdentity = {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)},
 2303:     ThirdIdentity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 2304:     Before = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2305:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, expire, [1 bsl 60]),
 2306:     ?assertEqual(
 2307:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS])),
 2308:     ?assertEqual(
 2309:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?THIRD_NS])),
 2310:     Parent = self(),
 2311:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2312:     _Caller = spawn(
 2313:                 fun() ->
 2314:                     Result = peer:call(
 2315:                                Asker, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 2316:                                [?ASKER_NS,
 2317:                                 {'::', ?NS, {via_fourth, {'X'}}}],
 2318:                                60000),
 2319:                     Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2320:                 end),
 2321:     try
 2322:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, TargetIdentity, 500),
 2323:         ok = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 2),
 2324:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, ThirdIdentity, 500),
 2325:         ok = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 2),
 2326:         ?assertMatch(
 2327:            {ok, [#{'X' := _}], _},
 2328:            receive
 2329:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2330:            after 10000 ->
 2331:                ct:fail(four_scope_route_wake_timeout)
 2332:            end),
 2333:         After = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2334:         ?assert(maps:get(route_demanded, After) >=
 2335:                     maps:get(route_demanded, Before) + 2),
 2336:         ?assert(maps:get(route_wakes, After) >=
 2337:                     maps:get(route_wakes, Before) + 2)
 2338:     after
 2339:         %% Restore complete generations even if the assertion failed so this
 2340:         %% suite never leaves a hidden route dependency for later cleanup.
 2341:         _ = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 3),
 2342:         _ = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 3)
 2343:     end.
 2344: 
 2345: wait_route_demand(_Peer, Identity, 0) ->
 2346:     ct:fail({route_demand_timeout, Identity});
 2347: wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries) ->
 2348:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []) of
 2349:         #{route_demands := Demands} ->
 2350:             case lists:member(Identity, Demands) of
 2351:                 true -> ok;
 2352:                 false ->
 2353:                     timer:sleep(10),
 2354:                     wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2355:             end;
 2356:         _ ->
 2357:             timer:sleep(10),
 2358:             wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2359:     end.
 2360: 
 2361: install_chain_target_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2362:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2363:     case peer:call(
 2364:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2365:            [?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 2366:             [{?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), validator},
 2367:              {?FOURTH_NS, ?config(fourth_anchor, Config), validator},
 2368:              {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}],
 2369:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2370:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2371:         Other -> Other
 2372:     end.
 2373: 
 2374: install_chain_third_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2375:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2376:     case peer:call(
 2377:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2378:            [?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 2379:             [{?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config), validator},
 2380:              {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), observer}],
 2381:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2382:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2383:         Other -> Other
 2384:     end.
 2385: 
 2386: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config) ->
 2387:     wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, 300).
 2388: 
 2389: wait_vote_barrier(_ProofRef, _Phase, Config, 0) ->
 2390:     ct:fail({dtx_vote_barrier_timeout, dtx_diagnostics(Config)});
 2391: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries) ->
 2392:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2393:     case peer:call(
 2394:            Asker, application, get_env,
 2395:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]) of
 2396:         {ok, {held, <<_:256>> = GroupId, Phase, _BarrierRef}} ->
 2397:             %% The gate is before the next planner drive, not a timed guess.
 2398:             GroupId;
 2399:         _ ->
 2400:             receive
 2401:                 {ProofRef, ProofResult} ->
 2402:                     ct:fail({group_proof_ended_before_vote, ProofResult})
 2403:             after 0 ->
 2404:                 timer:sleep(50),
 2405:                 wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries - 1)
 2406:             end
 2407:     end.
 2408: 
 2409: assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2410:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, vote},
 2411:     {ok, {phase, _, _, {committed, Ref}}, _} = peer:call(
 2412:         Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local, [Ns, Request, [], 1000]),
 2413:     {ok, Identity, _, _} = quod_dtx:certified_ref_binding(Ref),
 2414:     Deadline = peer:call(Peer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 2415:     {ok, #{control := Control}} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log,
 2416:         resolve_reference, [Identity, Ref, vote, none, none, Deadline]),
 2417:     ?assertMatch({quod_dtx_vote, 4, _, _, _, prepared},
 2418:                  quod_atomic:control_body(Control)).
 2419: 
 2420: assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2421:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, resolve},
 2422:     ?assertMatch(
 2423:        {ok, {phase, _, _, not_found}, []},
 2424:        peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2425:                  [Ns, Request, [], 1000])).
 2426: 
 2427: wait_remote_effect_state(_Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, 0) ->
 2428:     ct:fail({effect_state_timeout, Ns, GroupRef, Expected});
 2429: wait_remote_effect_state(Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries) ->
 2430:     Rows = peer:call(Peer, quod_effect_journal, rows, []),
 2431:     case [State || #{target := {RowNs, _}, ref := RowRef,
 2432:                      state := State} <- Rows,
 2433:                    RowNs =:= Ns,
 2434:                    element(1, RowRef) =:= group_effect,
 2435:                    element(3, RowRef) =:= GroupRef] of
 2436:         [Expected] -> ok;
 2437:         _ ->
 2438:             timer:sleep(20),
 2439:             wait_remote_effect_state(
 2440:               Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries - 1)
 2441:     end.
 2442: 
 2443: dtx_diagnostics(Config) ->
 2444:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2445:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2446:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2447:     Statuses =
 2448:         [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])}
 2449:          || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2450:                            {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2451:     GroupId =
 2452:         case proplists:get_value(?ASKER_NS, Statuses, #{}) of
 2453:             #{dtx_coordinators := Coordinators} ->
 2454:                 single_coordinator_id(Coordinators);
 2455:             _ -> undefined
 2456:         end,
 2457:     AskerInternal = dtx_internal_diagnostics(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2458:     Phases =
 2459:         case GroupId of
 2460:             <<_:256>> ->
 2461:                 [{Ns,
 2462:                   [{Kind,
 2463:                     peer:call(
 2464:                       Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2465:                       [Ns, {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 2466:                             GroupId, Kind}, [], 1000])}
 2467:                    || Kind <- [vote, resolve, complete]]}
 2468:                  || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2469:                                    {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]];
 2470:             _ ->
 2471:                 []
 2472:         end,
 2473:     BVote = phase_result(?NS, Phases, vote),
 2474:     CVote = phase_result(?THIRD_NS, Phases, vote),
 2475:     RawBVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2476:                    Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config),
 2477:                    ?config(target_addr, Config), BVote),
 2478:     RawCVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2479:                    Asker, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 2480:                    ?config(third_addr, Config), CVote),
 2481:     #{statuses => Statuses, phases => Phases,
 2482:       asker_internal => AskerInternal,
 2483:       raw_b_vote_verify => RawBVerify,
 2484:       raw_c_vote_verify => RawCVerify,
 2485:       foreign_log_stats =>
 2486:           [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, stats, [])}
 2487:            || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2488:                              {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2489:       asker_routes =>
 2490:           [{Ns, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [Ns])}
 2491:            || Ns <- [?NS, ?THIRD_NS]],
 2492:       third_origin_routes =>
 2493:           peer:call(Third, quod_directory, validator_routes,
 2494:                     [?ASKER_NS,
 2495:                      peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash,
 2496:                                [?ASKER_NS])])}.

 2498: raw_vote_verify(
 2499:   Peer, Validator, Endpoint,
 2500:   {ok, {phase, _RequestId, _Generation, {committed, Ref}}, _}) ->
 2501:     peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, verify,
 2502:               [Validator, Endpoint, Ref, vote, 5000]);
 2503: raw_vote_verify(_Peer, _Validator, _Endpoint, _PhaseResult) ->
 2504:     not_committed.

 2506: phase_result(Ns, Phases, Kind) ->
 2507:     case lists:keyfind(Ns, 1, Phases) of
 2508:         {Ns, Results} ->
 2509:             case lists:keyfind(Kind, 1, Results) of
 2510:                 {Kind, Result} -> Result;
 2511:                 false -> not_queried
 2512:             end;
 2513:         false -> not_queried
 2514:     end.

 2516: dtx_internal_diagnostics(Peer, Ns) ->
 2517:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2518:     case peer:call(Peer, sys, get_state, [Simplex]) of
 2519:         {running, State} ->
 2520:             Coordinator = peer:call(
 2521:                             Peer, quod_simplex,
 2522:                             test_dtx_coordinator_state, [State]),
 2523:             Counts = peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex,
 2524:                                test_dtx_endpoint_counts, [State]),
 2525:             #{coordinator => Coordinator,
 2526:               endpoint_counts => Counts};
 2527:         Other ->
 2528:             #{state => Other}
 2529:     end.

 2539: wait_restarted(_Peer, _Ns, _OldSimplex, 0) ->
 2540:     ct:fail(origin_namespace_did_not_restart);
 2541: wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries) ->
 2542:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2543:     Prolog = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, Ns}]),
 2544:     case is_pid(Simplex) andalso Simplex =/= OldSimplex andalso
 2545:          is_pid(Prolog) of
 2546:         true -> ok;
 2547:         false -> timer:sleep(25),
 2548:                  wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries - 1)
 2549:     end.

 2551: wait_group_outcome(_Peer, GroupRef, 0) ->
 2552:     ct:fail({group_outcome_never_became_terminal, GroupRef});
 2553: wait_group_outcome(Peer, {group, Ns, _, _, _, _} = GroupRef, Retries) ->
 2554:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, outcome, [GroupRef]) of
 2555:         {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2556:           when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted -> Outcome;
 2557:         {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2558:             timer:sleep(50),
 2559:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2560:         {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}} ->
 2561:             timer:sleep(50),
 2562:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2563:         {error, {ontology_rebuilding, Ns}} ->
 2564:             timer:sleep(50),
 2565:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2566:         Other ->
 2567:             ct:fail({unexpected_group_outcome, Other})
 2568:     end.

 2582: append_source_marker(Config, Tag) ->
 2583:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2584:     Author = ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 2585:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2586:     {ok, Goal} = quod_durable_term:encode_goal({test_source_marker, Tag}),
 2587:     {ok, Result} = quod_durable_term:encode_result(#{}),
 2588:     PlanDigest = crypto:hash(
 2589:                    sha256,
 2590:                    term_to_binary({test_source_marker, Tag},
 2591:                                   [deterministic])),
 2592:     Change = quod_transaction:bind_id(
 2593:                {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2594:                #transaction{tx_id = <<>>,
 2595:                             origin = {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2596:                             proof_id = <<0:256>>, plan_digest = PlanDigest,
 2597:                             goal = Goal, result = Result,
 2598:                             diff = [{assert,
 2599:                                      {{instance_of, pet,
 2600:                                        {stale_origin_marker, Tag}}, true}}],
 2601:                             read_check = #{}, author = Author, sig = none}),
 2602:     ?assertMatch({ok, _},
 2603:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, append,
 2604:                            [?ASKER_NS, Change], 60000)).

 2649: classify_race_submit(
 2650:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, _Bindings, _Outcome}}}) ->
 2651:     {accepted, Evidence};
 2652: classify_race_submit(
 2653:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {pending, _PendingRef}}}) ->
 2654:     %% A multi-ontology proof may already be durably represented by its group
 2655:     %% reference.  The signed operation remains the stable public lookup key
 2656:     %% in either case, and is resolved below without resubmitting.
 2657:     {accepted, Evidence};

 2694: wait_operation_claim(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2695:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2696: wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2697:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2698:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2699:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2700:                 {ok, #{status := committed} = Outcome} -> {Claim, Outcome};
 2701:                 {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2702:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2703:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2704:                 {error, _} ->
 2705:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2706:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2707:                 Other ->
 2708:                     ct:fail({unexpected_operation_outcome, Other})
 2709:             end;
 2710:         {error, _} ->
 2711:             timer:sleep(50),
 2712:             wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2713:         Other ->
 2714:             ct:fail({unexpected_operation_claim, Other})
 2715:     end.
 2716: 
 2717: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2718:     ct:fail(
 2719:       {operation_completion_timeout, OperationRef,
 2720:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS])});
 2721: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2722:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2723:         {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 2724:                outcome_ref := {applications, [OutcomeRef]}, included := Included}} ->
 2725:             ?assertMatch([{_, {certified, OutcomeRef, _}}], Included),
 2726:             ?assertEqual({ok, [OutcomeRef]}, quod_operation_vector:receipt_references(Included)),
 2727:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2728:                 {ok, #{status := committed, ref := OutcomeRef}} -> OutcomeRef;
 2729:                 _ ->
 2730:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2731:                     completed_remote_operation(
 2732:                       Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2733:             end;
 2734:         _ ->
 2735:             timer:sleep(50),
 2736:             completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2737:     end.
 2738: 
 2739: wait_operation_terminal(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2740:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2741: wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2742:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2743:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2744:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2745:                 {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2746:                   when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted ->
 2747:                     {Claim, Outcome};
 2748:                 _ ->
 2749:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2750:                     wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2751:             end;
 2752:         _ ->
 2753:             timer:sleep(50),
 2754:             wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2755:     end.

 2757: wait_remote_operation(_Gateway, _SessionId, _RequestBytes, _Signature,
 2758:                       _ClientPeer, 0) ->
 2759:     ct:fail(remote_operation_outcome_timeout);
 2760: wait_remote_operation(Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2761:                       ClientPeer, Remaining) ->
 2762:     Result = peer:call(
 2763:                Gateway, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 2764:                [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 10000),
 2765:     case Result of
 2766:         {ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, _}} -> Result;
 2767:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2768:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2769:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} ->
 2770:             timer:sleep(250),
 2771:             wait_remote_operation(
 2772:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2773:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2774:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2775:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2776:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} ->
 2777:             timer:sleep(250),
 2778:             wait_remote_operation(
 2779:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2780:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2781:         Other ->
 2782:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_invalid, Other})
 2783:     end.

 2789:     ?assertEqual(#{}, maps:get(groups, Dtx)),

 2792: run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, Wave) ->
 2793:     %% `run_scope_proofs/3` owns a 10-second completion window. The peer call
 2794:     %% must outlive it; its default five seconds can otherwise time out before
 2795:     %% the helper can report the actual wave result.
 2796:     Results = peer:call(
 2797:                 Asker, ?MODULE, run_scope_proofs,
 2798:                 [?ASKER_NS, Goal, ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE], 15000),
 2799:     case Results of
 2800:         List when is_list(List), length(List) =:= ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE ->
 2801:             lists:foreach(
 2802:               fun({ok, [_], _}) -> ok;
 2803:                  (Result) -> ct:fail({scope_proof_failed, Wave, Result})
 2804:               end, List);
 2805:         timeout -> ct:fail({scope_proof_timeout, Wave});
 2806:         Other -> ct:fail({scope_proof_wave_failed, Wave, Other})
 2807:     end.
 2808: 
 2809: run_scope_proofs(Ns, Goal, Count) ->
 2810:     Parent = self(),
 2811:     _ = [spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {proof_done, quod_prolog:prove(Ns, Goal)} end)
 2812:          || _ <- lists:seq(1, Count)],
 2813:     collect_scope_proofs(Count, []).
 2814: 
 2815: collect_scope_proofs(0, Results) -> lists:reverse(Results);
 2816: collect_scope_proofs(Count, Results) ->
 2817:     receive
 2818:         {proof_done, Result} -> collect_scope_proofs(Count - 1, [Result | Results])
 2819:     after 10000 ->
 2820:         timeout
 2821:     end.

 2834: open_client_session(Peer, NetworkId, NodeKey,
 2835:                     KeyPair = {PublicKey, _Seed}, ClientPeer) ->
 2836:     ClientNonce = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 2837:     {ok, Challenge} = peer:call(
 2838:                         Peer, quod_client_auth, issue_challenge,
 2839:                         [PublicKey, ClientNonce, ClientPeer]),
 2840:     ChallengeId = maps:get(challenge_id, Challenge),
 2841:     {ok, ChallengeBytes} = quod_client_auth:challenge_bytes(
 2842:                              NetworkId, NodeKey, ChallengeId, PublicKey,
 2843:                              ClientNonce, maps:get(server_nonce, Challenge),
 2844:                              maps:get(expires_ms, Challenge)),
 2845:     Signature = quod_identity:sign(
 2846:                   ChallengeBytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair)),
 2847:     {ok, Session} = peer:call(
 2848:                       Peer, quod_client_auth, complete_challenge,
 2849:                       [ChallengeId, Signature]),
 2850:     Session.

 2858: signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair,
 2859:                     AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 2860:                     SessionExpires, Mode, GoalText) ->
 2861:     Request = #{network_identity => NetworkId,
 2862:                 signing_public_key => PublicKey,

 2864:                 agent_namespace => AgentNamespace,
 2865:                 agent_genesis_anchor => AgentAnchor,
 2866:                 agent_instance_text => <<"human_user(test_agent).">>,
 2867:                 mode => Mode, parser_version => 1,
 2868:                 not_after_ms => min(
 2869:                                   SessionExpires,
 2870:                                   quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
 2871:                 goal_text => GoalText},
 2872:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(Request),
 2873:     {Bytes,
 2874:      quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair))}.

 2899: start_node(Name, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Ns, Genesis, Seeds,
 2900:            DirectoryAllowlist, Config) ->
 2901:     %% Peer nodes must load the beam being tested.  `code:get_path/0` also
 2902:     %% contains dependency and older build paths, so put this suite's exact
 2903:     %% Quod ebin first instead of relying on their incidental ordering.
 2904:     QuodEbin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
 2905:     PeerPaths = [QuodEbin | lists:delete(QuodEbin, code:get_path())],
 2906:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
 2907:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io,
 2908:                             args => ["-pa" | PeerPaths]}),
 2909:     lists:foreach(
 2910:       fun(Module) ->
 2911:           {module, Module} = peer:call(
 2912:                                Peer, code, ensure_loaded, [Module]),
 2913:           QuodEbin = filename:dirname(
 2914:                        peer:call(Peer, code, which, [Module]))
 2915:       end, [quod_simplex, quod_scope_session, quod_ask]),
 2916:     true = peer:call(
 2917:              Peer, erlang, function_exported,
 2918:              [quod_simplex, start_link, 2]),
 2919:     %% Runtime lifecycle preparation may legitimately use the application's
 2920:     %% default data root. Keep that root private to this peer and CT run: the
 2921:     %% VM-local unique_integer/1 sequence restarts in later runs, so sharing
 2922:     %% the developer cache could reopen an old genesis under a dead test key.
 2923:     CacheDir = filename:join(
 2924:                  ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2925:                  atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_cache"),
 2926:     true = peer:call(
 2927:              Peer, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", CacheDir]),
 2928:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
 2929:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
 2930:     Key = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
 2931:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
 2932:     Set(listen_port, Port),
 2933:     Set(node_addr, {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
 2934:     Set(node_pubkey, Pub),
 2935:     Set(identity_key, Key),
 2936:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
 2937:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir,
 2938:         filename:join(
 2939:           ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2940:           atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_effect_journal")),
 2941:     Set(foreign_log,
 2942:         #{cache_dir => filename:join(
 2943:                          ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2944:                          atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_foreign_log")}),
 2945:     %% These peers do not run the production directory-advertisement loop for
 2946:     %% every synthetic namespace. Keep their explicit certified route fixtures
 2947:     %% alive for the whole suite so long-running protocol cases test the route,
 2948:     %% not fixture expiry.
 2949:     _ = DirectoryAllowlist,
 2950:     Set(directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}),
 2951:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
 2952:     start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config),
 2953:     Peer.
 2954: 
 2955: start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config) ->
 2956:     DataDir = filename:join(
 2957:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2958:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 2959:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 2960:                    "_", Ns])),
 2961:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => create, role => member,
 2962:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds,
 2963:             genesis_file => Genesis},
 2964:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 2965:     ok.
 2966: 
 2967: start_join_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Anchor, Seeds, Config) ->
 2968:     DataDir = filename:join(
 2969:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2970:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 2971:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 2972:                    "_observer_", Ns])),
 2973:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor,
 2974:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds},
 2975:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 2976:     ok.
 2977: 
 2978: start_root_namespace(Peer, Pub, Config) ->
 2979:     DataDir = filename:join(
 2980:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 2981:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 2982:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 2983:                    "_", ?ROOT_NS])),
 2984:     Content = #{namespace => ?ROOT_NS, mode => create,
 2985:                 genesis_file => <<"ontologies/quod_root.pl">>,
 2986:                 data_dir => list_to_binary(DataDir), seeds => []},
 2987:     {?ROOT_NS, Cfg0} = peer:call(
 2988:                          Peer, quod_app, build_ns_config, [Content]),
 2989:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
 2990:                 Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
 2991:                 [?ROOT_NS, Cfg0#{node_id => Pub}]),
 2992:     ok.
 2993: 
 2994: start_brahms(Peer, Ns, SelfAddr, Seeds) ->
 2995:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
 2996:                         [Ns, #{node_id => SelfAddr, seed_peers => Seeds}]),
 2997:     ok.
 2998: 
 2999: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal) ->
 3000:     wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, 750).
 3001: 
 3002: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, _Goal, 0) ->
 3003:     ct:fail(
 3004:       {ontology_never_ready, Ns,
 3005:        #{children => peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, children, []),
 3006:          desired => peer:call(
 3007:                       Peer, application, get_env,
 3008:                       [quod, namespace_desired, undefined]),
 3009:          genesis => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 3010:          status => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]),
 3011:          prolog => peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns])}});
 3012: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries) ->
 3013:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 5000) of
 3014:         {error, rebuilding} ->
 3015:             timer:sleep(20),
 3016:             wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries - 1);
 3017:         {ok, _, _} -> ok;
 3018:         Other -> ct:fail({not_ready, Ns, Other})
 3019:     end.
 3020: 
 3021: wait_scope_workers(_Peer, _Expected, 0) -> ct:fail(scope_worker_timeout);
 3022: wait_scope_workers(Peer, Expected, Retries) ->
 3023:     wait_engine_stat(Peer, ?NS, scope_workers, Expected, Retries).
 3024: 
 3025: wait_engine_stat(_Peer, _Ns, _Key, _Expected, 0) ->
 3026:     ct:fail(engine_stat_timeout);
 3027: wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries) ->
 3028:     Stats = peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns]),
 3029:     case maps:get(Key, Stats, undefined) of
 3030:         Expected -> ok;
 3031:         _ ->
 3032:             timer:sleep(10),
 3033:             wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries - 1)
 3034:     end.
 3035: 
 3036: key_before(TargetPub) ->
 3037:     {Pub, _} = Key = quod_identity:generate(),
 3038:     case Pub < TargetPub of
 3039:         true -> Key;
 3040:         false -> key_before(TargetPub)
 3041:     end.
 3042: 
 3043: deep_failure_rules() ->
 3044:     [[io_lib:format("deep_failure(~B) :- deep_failure(~B).~n", [N, N - 1])
 3045:       || N <- lists:seq(70, 1, -1)],
 3046:      "deep_failure(0) :- fail_with_reason(deep_bottom).\n",
 3047:      %% Build the deliberately over-depth reason at proof time.  Canonical
 3048:      %% ledger material is depth-bounded, so embedding that value as a genesis
 3049:      %% literal would test genesis rejection instead of reply truncation.
 3050:      "bounded_reason :- deep_reason_value(63, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3051:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3052:      "deep_reason :- deep_reason_value(70, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3053:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3054:      "deep_reason_value(0, Acc, Acc).\n"
 3055:      "deep_reason_value(N, Acc, Out) :- N > 0, Next is N - 1, "
 3056:      "deep_reason_value(Next, [Acc], Out).\n"].
